name: 90-90 Hip Flexor Stretch
pose_description: Kneel on your right knee with your left foot planted in front of you, both legs bent at 90 degrees. Keep your torso upright and core engaged.

name: 90/90 Hip Stretch
pose_description: Seated on the floor with one leg bent 90 degrees in front (shin parallel to shoulders, knee pointing outward) and the other leg bent 90 degrees behind (shin pointing backward). Torso upright, hands on the floor for light support. Hips open, gentle forward lean over the front shin.

name: Abdominal Bracing
pose_description: Lying flat on back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor. The abdominal muscles are contracted as if bracing for a punch to the stomach, creating a rigid cylinder around the midsection. The spine maintains its natural curve, the ribs do not flare, and breathing continues normally while the brace is held.

name: Active Range of Motion Finger Straightening
pose_description: Sit with your hand resting on a table, palm down, allowing your fingers to naturally curl slightly. Begin from a relaxed, partially flexed position.

name: Adductor Stretching
pose_description: Lie on your back with both legs extended. Bend one knee and gently pull it toward your chest and across your body.

name: Ankle Alphabet
pose_description: Standing on one leg or seated with one leg crossed over the other. The foot of the elevated leg traces the letters of the alphabet in the air using ankle movements only, moving through all planes of motion. The lower leg remains still while the foot moves deliberately through each letter shape.

name: Ankle Alphabet Tracing
pose_description: Sit in a chair and extend one leg out in front of you or rest your foot on another chair. Keep your thigh supported and relaxed.

name: Ankle Circles
pose_description: Standing on one leg with light support from a chair or wall for balance. The opposite foot is lifted slightly off the ground and the ankle draws slow, controlled circles in the air, moving through full dorsiflexion, inversion, plantarflexion, and eversion. The knee of the circling leg remains relatively still.

name: Seated Ankle Inversion and Eversion
pose_description: Sit with your back against a chair, one knee extended and the other bent slightly with foot flat. Keep your extended leg relaxed on a stool or ottoman.

name: Ankle Pumps
pose_description: Sit in a chair with feet flat on the floor, knees bent at 90 degrees. Keep your thighs parallel to the ground.

name: Seated Anterior Tibialis Stretch
pose_description: Sit upright and cross one ankle over the opposite knee, creating a figure-4 position. Keep your back straight.

name: Arch Doming Exercise
pose_description: Stand barefoot with feet hip-width apart, weight evenly distributed, and hands resting on a wall or table for balance. Keep your toes flat on the ground.

name: Arch Doming and Foot Intrinsic Strengthening
pose_description: Sit upright with your feet flat on the floor, toes pointed forward. Relax your foot completely and focus on the arch region of the sole of your foot.

name: Arch Strengthening with Towel Scrunches
pose_description: Sit in a chair with a small towel spread flat on the floor in front of you. Place your bare foot on the towel with toes relaxed.

name: Arm Circles
pose_description: Stand with feet hip-width apart and arms extended out to the sides at shoulder height. Keep your core engaged and maintain an upright posture.

name: Active Range of Motion Arm Circles
pose_description: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and your arms extended out to the sides at shoulder height. Keep a slight bend in your elbows.

name: Arm Elevation with Deep Breathing
pose_description: Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart and arms relaxed at your sides. Keep your shoulders relaxed and take a deep breath in through your nose.

name: Assisted Cat-Cow Stretch
pose_description: Begin on hands and knees with a resistance band looped around your back and holding both ends in your hands. Your spine should be in a neutral position.

name: Balance Walk - Tandem Stance
pose_description: Standing in a STATIC tandem stance pose: both feet planted firmly on the floor in a single straight line, with the heel of the front foot touching the toe of the back foot. Arms are extended out to the sides at shoulder height for balance. Both feet are flat on the floor, NOT walking, NOT lifted, NOT mid-step. The figure is holding a still balance pose, gaze forward.

name: Banded Standing Marches Regen
pose_description: (none)

name: Belly Breathing with Leg Lifts
pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor, and hands on your belly. Focus on breathing into your diaphragm.

name: Bicep Curls
pose_description: Standing upright with a dumbbell or resistance band in each hand, arms at sides with palms facing forward. The forearms curl upward by bending the elbows, bringing the weights toward the shoulders while keeping the elbows pinned at the sides. The torso remains still without swaying, and the upper arms do not move.

name: Big Arm Circles
pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and arms extended out to the sides at shoulder height. Keep your chest upright and core engaged.

name: Big Backward Steps
pose_description: Stand upright facing forward with feet together and arms at your sides. Keep your core tight and posture tall.

name: Big Head Turns
pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with your head facing forward and shoulders relaxed. Keep your trunk stable and only move your head.

name: Big Reaching Overhead
pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and arms resting at your sides. Keep your posture upright with your core engaged.

name: Big Stepping Backward
pose_description: Stand upright with feet together and hands on a stable surface for support if needed. Maintain an upright posture and forward gaze.

name: Big Stepping Forward
pose_description: Stand upright with feet together and arms at your sides or extended forward for balance. Keep your chest upright and core engaged.

name: Big Stepping Sideways
pose_description: Stand upright with feet together and hands on a stable surface or extended for balance. Maintain an upright posture throughout.

name: Big Steps Forward
pose_description: Stand upright with feet together and arms at your sides or holding light dumbbells. Maintain an upright posture with core engaged.

name: Big Toe Flexion Strengthening
pose_description: Sit in a chair with feet flat on the floor. Place a small towel on the floor under your foot.

name: Big Toe Joint Mobilization
pose_description: Sit in a chair with one leg crossed over the opposite knee, bringing the foot closer to your body. Grasp your big toe gently with your hand.

name: Big Trunk Rotations
pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, arms crossed over chest or extended out to sides. Maintain upright posture with slight knee bend.

name: Bird Dogs
pose_description: Start on hands and knees with wrists under shoulders and knees under hips, maintaining a neutral spine. Engage your core to prevent any sagging in the lower back.

name: Bodyweight Squats
pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, arms extended forward for balance, and chest upright. Keep your weight distributed evenly across both feet.

name: Box Jumps
pose_description: Stand facing a sturdy box or platform with feet hip-width apart. Your arms are ready to swing and core is engaged.

name: Breathing Exercises with Arm Positioning
pose_description: Sit upright in a comfortable chair with both feet flat on the floor and arms resting on your thighs. Close your eyes or maintain a soft gaze.

name: Bridge Hold
pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor hip-width apart, and arms at your sides with palms down. Keep your head and shoulders relaxed on the mat.

name: Bridging with Pelvic Floor Engagement
pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor hip-width apart, and arms at your sides. Engage your pelvic floor muscles before initiating movement.

name: Brisk Walking
pose_description: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart and arms at your sides. Engage your core and maintain an upright posture with shoulders relaxed.

name: Butterfly Stretch
pose_description: Sit upright with the soles of your feet together and knees falling out to the sides, forming a diamond shape with your legs. Keep your back straight and core engaged.

name: Calf Raises
pose_description: Stand upright with your feet hip-width apart, hands resting on a support bar or wall for light balance assistance. Keep your core engaged and posture tall.

name: Calf Raises on Both Feet
pose_description: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, hands lightly touching a wall or bar for balance. Keep your weight distributed evenly across both feet.

name: Calf Raises with Handrail Support
pose_description: Stand facing a gym railing with both hands holding it for support. Feet are hip-width apart with weight distributed evenly through all toes.

name: Calf Raises on Step
pose_description: Stand on one leg on a step or stair with the affected ankle positioned so the heel hangs slightly off the edge. The other leg is lifted for balance with a slight bend in the standing knee.

name: Calf Stretch
pose_description: Stand facing a wall with your hands on the wall at shoulder height. Step one leg back, keeping the heel on the ground.

name: Calf Stretch on Step
pose_description: Standing on the edge of a step with the balls of the feet on the step and the heels hanging off the back edge. One or both heels drop below the level of the step, creating a deep stretch in the calf muscles. Hands hold a railing or wall for balance, and the knees are straight to target the gastrocnemius.

name: Calf Stretches Against Wall
pose_description: Stand facing a wall with your hands on the wall at shoulder height, feet hip-width apart. Place one leg forward with a slight knee bend and the other leg extended straight behind you.

name: Calf Stretches
pose_description: Stand facing a wall with your hands placed on the wall at shoulder height for balance. Step the affected leg back about 12 inches.

name: Cat-Camel Stretch
pose_description: Start on hands and knees with a neutral spine, hands under shoulders and knees under hips. Keep your head in neutral alignment with your spine.

name: Cat-Cow Mobilization
pose_description: Start on your hands and knees with wrists under shoulders and knees under hips. Spine is in neutral position with gaze toward the ground.

name: Cat-Cow Stretch
pose_description: On hands and knees in tabletop position, wrists under shoulders, knees under hips. The spine is arched upward like a cat, rounding toward the ceiling, head tucked down. Wearing a gray t-shirt and dark shorts.

name: Cervical Isometric Holds
pose_description: Sit upright with shoulders relaxed and spine neutral. Place your hand gently against the side of your head at temple level.

name: Cervical Isometric Lateral Flexion
pose_description: Sit upright with shoulders relaxed and head in neutral position. Place your right hand on the right side of your head.

name: Cervical Isometric Neck Extension
pose_description: Sit upright with good posture and head in neutral position. Place your hand on the back of your head with elbow bent.

name: Cervical Isometric Neck Flexion
pose_description: Sit upright with shoulders relaxed and head in neutral position. Place your hand on your forehead with elbow bent.

name: Cervical Neck Stretches
pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with neutral posture and shoulders relaxed. Keep your hands resting in your lap or on your thighs.

name: Cervical Retraction
pose_description: Sit upright with your eyes looking straight ahead and your shoulders relaxed. Your neck is in a neutral position.

name: Cervical Retraction with Isometric Hold
pose_description: Sit upright with shoulders relaxed and spine neutral. Gently tuck your chin and slide your head straight back, ensuring the back of your neck lengthens. Keep your gaze level and forward.

name: Cervical Retraction with Resistance
pose_description: Sit upright with good posture and place your hand against your chin. Your neck is in a neutral position.

name: Cheek Puff Exercise
pose_description: Sit upright with your mouth closed and cheeks in their natural relaxed state. Keep your lips sealed but not pressed tightly together.

name: Chest Doorway Stretch
pose_description: Stand in a doorway with your affected arm raised to 90 degrees at the shoulder, elbow bent at 90 degrees, and forearm resting on the doorframe. Keep your chest upright and core engaged.

name: Chest Opener Stretch
pose_description: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and interlace your fingers behind your back at hip level. Your shoulders are relaxed and your posture is upright.

name: Chest Press Machine
pose_description: Sit upright on the machine with back firmly against the pad and feet flat on the floor. Grip the handles at chest level with elbows bent at 90 degrees.

name: Chest Stretch
pose_description: Stand upright with good posture, feet hip-width apart. Clasp your hands behind your back with arms extended.

name: Chest Stretch Corner
pose_description: Standing facing a corner of a room with one foot slightly forward. Both forearms are placed on the adjoining walls at approximately shoulder height with elbows bent at 90 degrees. The body leans into the corner until a stretch is felt across the chest and front of the shoulders. The core is engaged and the lower back does not arch excessively.

name: Chest Wall Mobility Stretch
pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and clasp your hands behind your back at waist level. Keep your spine neutral and shoulders relaxed.

name: Child's Pose
pose_description: A yoga child's pose: sitting back on the heels with the body folded completely forward and down, forehead on the ground, arms extended straight forward along the floor. The back is rounded and the person looks like they are bowing down.

name: Child's Pose with Side Reach
pose_description: A person kneels with their hips resting back on their heels, knees slightly apart. The torso folds forward between the thighs, with the forehead gently resting on the floor. Arms are extended straight forward on the floor, palms flat.

name: Chin Tucks
pose_description: Stand tall with your back straight and shoulders relaxed. Look straight ahead, keeping your head in a neutral position with your ears aligned directly above your shoulders.

name: Clam Shells
pose_description: Lie on your side with hips and knees bent to approximately 45 degrees, feet together. Support your head with your lower arm.

name: Clamshells
pose_description: Side-lying hip exercise. The man is on his side like a sleeping position, facing the viewer. Head propped on bottom arm. Both knees are bent. The top leg's knee is raised up toward the ceiling while feet stay together. View from front showing the side-lying body clearly.

name: Clock Reach
pose_description: Stand on one leg in the center of an imaginary clock face, lightly touching a wall or railing for balance. Keep your standing leg slightly bent and core engaged.

name: Neuromuscular Re-education - Coordinated Expressions
pose_description: Sit facing a mirror with a neutral expression and completely relaxed facial muscles. Keep your head still and your shoulders down.

name: Copenhagen Adduction
pose_description: Side-lying on the floor with the top leg resting on a bench or elevated surface. The bottom leg is hanging free beneath the bench. The person lifts the bottom leg up toward the bench by squeezing the inner thigh (adductors). The upper body is propped on the forearm in a side plank position. The top leg stays on the bench for support.

name: Copenhagen Adductor Squeeze
pose_description: Lie on your left side with hips and knees bent at 45 degrees. Place a cushion or foam pad between your knees, positioned just above knee level.

name: Core Plank (Foot Neutral Position)
pose_description: Lie face down with forearms on the ground, elbows directly under shoulders, and feet together or slightly apart with toes on the ground. Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.

name: Couch Stretch
pose_description: Kneeling on one knee with the back foot elevated against a wall or couch behind. Front leg is bent at 90 degrees with foot flat on the floor. Torso tall and upright, hands on the front knee for balance. Deep stretch visible in the hip flexor and quadriceps of the back leg.

name: Dead Bug With Dumbbell Regen
pose_description: (none)

name: Dead Bug Regen
pose_description: (none)

name: Dead Bugs
pose_description: Lie on your back with arms extended straight up toward the ceiling and knees bent at 90 degrees, shins parallel to the ground. Keep your lower back pressed to the floor.

name: Deadlifts
pose_description: Stand with feet hip-width apart, barbell on the ground close to your shins. Your back is straight, chest up, and shoulders slightly in front of the bar.

name: Deep Abdominal Breathing
pose_description: Sit upright in a comfortable chair with feet flat on the floor and one hand on your chest and one on your abdomen. Maintain relaxed shoulders and neutral spine.

name: Deep Abdominal Engagement
pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor, and hands resting on your lower abdomen. Breathe normally and relax your abdominal muscles.

name: Deep Breathing with Body Scan
pose_description: Lie flat on your back on a comfortable surface with legs extended and arms slightly away from your body, palms facing up. Close your eyes and allow your shoulders to relax down and away from your ears.

name: Deep Squat Hold with Relaxation
pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, weight distributed evenly through both feet. Hands can be held in front for light support if needed.

name: Diaphragmatic Breathing
pose_description: Lying flat on back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor. One hand rests on the upper chest and the other on the belly just below the ribcage. During inhalation, the belly rises prominently while the chest remains relatively still. During exhalation, the belly falls inward. The breathing is slow, deep, and controlled through the nose.

name: Diaphragmatic Breathing in Supine
pose_description: Lie flat on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Place one hand on your chest and one on your abdomen.

name: DIP (Finger) Flexion and Extension
pose_description: Sit upright with your forearm supported on a table, palm facing down. The affected finger hangs off the edge of the table while other fingers remain flat on the surface.

name: DIP Joint Active Motion
pose_description: Sit with your forearm resting on a table, palm down. Keep the MCP and PIP joints stationary while focusing on the distal interphalangeal (DIP) joint.

name: Doorway Chest Stretch
pose_description: Stand in a doorway with your affected arm raised to 90 degrees, elbow bent, and your forearm against the door frame. Step one foot forward into a slight lunge position.

name: Doorway Pec Stretch Rotation Regen
pose_description: (none)

name: Doorway Pectoral Stretch
pose_description: Stand in a doorway with your right arm raised to 90 degrees, placing your forearm against the door frame. Your body faces straight ahead with good posture.

name: Doorway Shoulder Stretch
pose_description: Stand in a doorway with your right arm raised to 90 degrees and forearm resting against the doorframe. Position your body so you face the doorframe.

name: Doorway Stretch
pose_description: Standing in a doorway facing through it. Both arms are raised to shoulder height with elbows bent at 90 degrees, forearms pressed against each side of the door frame. The body leans forward through the doorway to stretch the chest. One foot is slightly ahead of the other.

name: Dorsiflexion Hold Against Gravity
pose_description: Lie on your back with both legs extended, feet pointing toward the ceiling. Keep your arms at your sides.

name: Double Knee-to-Chest
pose_description: Lying flat on back with both knees pulled up toward the chest simultaneously. Both hands wrap around the shins or behind the thighs, hugging the knees close. The lower back rounds gently into the floor, the tailbone lifts slightly, and the head and shoulders remain relaxed on the ground.

name: Double Leg Calf Raise
pose_description: Standing upright with feet hip-width apart, lightly holding a wall or railing for balance. Both heels rise simultaneously as high as possible, pushing up onto the balls of the feet. The knees remain straight, the body is tall, and the calf muscles fully contract at the top of the movement.

name: Double-Leg Glute Bridge
pose_description: Lie on your back on a mat with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Your arms are at your sides with palms facing down.

name: Double Leg Heel Raises on Stairs
pose_description: Stand on a stair or step with balls of feet on the edge and heels hanging off, holding a rail for light support. Feet are hip-width apart.

name: Downward Facing Dog
pose_description: Starting from hands and knees, the figure pushes hips up and back into an inverted V shape. Arms are straight and extended overhead pressing into the floor, head between the upper arms looking toward the feet. Legs are straight with heels pressing toward the ground. Back is flat forming a straight line from hands to hips.

name: Dumbbell Chest Press Regen
pose_description: (none)

name: Dumbbell Floor Press Regen
pose_description: (none)

name: Dumbbell Rows Regen
pose_description: (none)

name: Dynamic Adductor Stretch With Hip Rotation Regen
pose_description: (none)

name: Eccentric Calf Lowering
pose_description: Standing on the edge of a step with the balls of both feet on the step. Starting from a full calf raise on both feet, the weight transfers to one leg, and that heel slowly lowers below the step level over three to five seconds. The knee remains straight, and the opposite foot assists for the return to the top position.

name: Eccentric Hamstring Curls
pose_description: Lie face down on a bench or stability ball with legs extended and toes pointed toward the floor. Place hands by your sides for light support.

name: Eccentric Wrist Flexion
pose_description: Sit with your forearm supported on a table, holding a light dumbbell with your palm facing up and wrist bent upward. Your opposite hand assists to lift the weight.

name: Elbow Flexion Stretch with Towel
pose_description: Stand with your right arm raised overhead and bent at the elbow, so your hand drops behind your back. Relax your shoulders and maintain an upright posture.

name: Elbow Flexion and Extension
pose_description: Sit upright with your arm at your side, elbow bent at 90 degrees with palm facing forward. Keep your upper arm stationary against your body throughout the movement.

name: Elbow Flexion with Light Resistance
pose_description: Sit upright in a chair and hold a light dumbbell (1-3 lbs) in your affected hand with your arm at your side and palm facing forward. Keep your elbow bent at 90 degrees.

name: Elbow Flexion Stretch
pose_description: Stand upright with your affected arm extended in front of you at shoulder height, palm facing down. Your opposite hand is ready to assist.

name: Elbow Range of Motion Pendulum
pose_description: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and bend forward slightly at the waist, letting your affected arm hang down naturally from your shoulder. Keep your arm relaxed and loose.

name: Extensor Carpi Radialis Stretch
pose_description: Sit with your arm extended in front of you, elbow straight, with your palm facing downward. Your opposite hand is positioned to apply gentle pressure.

name: External Rotation Regen
pose_description: (none)

name: Eye Closure Strengthening
pose_description: Sit upright facing a mirror with eyes open and a neutral expression. Keep your head still and relaxed.

name: Eye Closure and Blinking
pose_description: Sit upright with eyes open, looking straight ahead in a relaxed manner. Keep your face still and avoid any compensatory movements.

name: Facial Mirror Exercises - Smile
pose_description: Sit upright in front of a mirror with a neutral facial expression. Keep your head still and relaxed with your shoulders down.

name: Farmer's Carry
pose_description: Stand upright holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides with your shoulders packed back and core engaged. Maintain a neutral spine throughout.

name: Figure-4 Stretch
pose_description: Lie on your back with both knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Cross one ankle over the opposite knee to create a figure-4 shape.

name: Finger Abduction and Adduction
pose_description: Sit with your hand flat on a table, fingers spread slightly apart. Keep your palm and forearm relaxed against the table.

name: Finger Desensitization Tapping
pose_description: Sit comfortably with your affected arm supported on a table. Rest your fingers flat on the table surface.

name: Finger Dexterity Exercises with Putty
pose_description: Sit in a comfortable position and hold soft therapy putty in your hand with fingers relaxed and extended. The putty should be soft enough to manipulate without pain.

name: Finger Flexion Exercises
pose_description: Sit upright with your forearm resting on a table, palm facing up. Keep your fingers extended and relaxed.

name: Finger Flexion and Extension
pose_description: Sit comfortably with your hand relaxed in front of you, fingers extended straight. Your wrist is in neutral position.

name: Finger Flexor and Extensor Exercises
pose_description: Sit with your forearms resting on a table, palms facing down. Keep wrists in neutral position without bending.

name: Finger Flexor Stretch
pose_description: Sit with your arm extended in front of you at shoulder height, palm facing up with fingers relaxed. Your opposite hand is ready to assist with gentle pressure.

name: Finger Isolation Flexion
pose_description: Sit upright with your hand resting on a table, palm facing down with fingers extended. Your wrist is in a neutral position.

name: Finger Isolation Lifts
pose_description: Sit with your forearm resting on a table, palm down with fingers extended. Keep all fingers relaxed and in contact with the table.

name: Finger Isolation and Tapping
pose_description: Sit with your hand resting on a table, palm facing downward with the mallet finger splint in place. Your fingers are extended in a relaxed position.

name: Finger Isometric Hold
pose_description: Sit upright with your forearm resting on a table, palm facing up with fingers extended. Your affected hand should be relaxed and supported by the table surface.

name: Finger Spread and Squeeze
pose_description: Sit upright with your hand relaxed and fingers slightly together in front of you. Your palm should be facing downward in a neutral position.

name: Finger Tapping Exercise
pose_description: Sit with your hand relaxed and flat on a table, fingers extended naturally. Your hand should be completely supported and at rest.

name: Finger Tendon Glides
pose_description: Standing or seated with one hand extended in front, palm facing away. The fingers move through a series of positions: straight extension, hook fist (tips bent to pads), full fist, straight fist (fingers curled at knuckles only), and tabletop (fingers bent at knuckles to 90 degrees with fingertips pointing forward). Each position is held briefly before transitioning.

name: Fire Hydrants
pose_description: On hands and knees in tabletop position with wrists under shoulders and knees under hips. One knee remains bent at 90 degrees and lifts out to the side, opening the hip like a fire hydrant, to approximately hip height. The spine stays neutral, the core is braced, and the pelvis does not rotate or shift.

name: Foam Roller Quad Regen
pose_description: (none)

name: Forearm Isometric Strengthening
pose_description: Sit with your forearm supported on a table with your palm facing down. Keep your hand in neutral position with fingers extended and splint in place.

name: Forearm Plank with Hand Position Variation
pose_description: Start in a forearm plank position with your forearms on the ground, shoulders directly above elbows, and your body in a straight line. Keep your core engaged and neutral spine.

name: Forearm Plank on Knees
pose_description: Start on your knees with forearms on the ground, elbows under shoulders, and hands flat or in fists. Keep your core engaged and body in a straight line from knees to head.

name: Forearm Plank with Wrist Awareness
pose_description: Lie face down with your forearms on the ground, elbows directly under your shoulders. Your body is straight from head to heels, supported on your forearms and toes.

name: Forearm Pronation Isometric Hold
pose_description: Sit with your elbow bent at 90 degrees, forearm in neutral position (palm facing inward). Hold a light dumbbell with your hand.

name: Forearm Pronation Stretch
pose_description: Sit with your arm extended at shoulder height, palm facing down. Use your opposite hand to gently hold the back of your hand.

name: Forearm Pronation and Supination
pose_description: Sit with your elbow bent to 90 degrees and tucked against your body, palm facing up (supinated position). Keep your forearm steady.

name: Forearm Pronation Wall Walk
pose_description: Stand facing a wall, about 12 inches away with your feet hip-width apart. Place your affected palm flat against the wall at waist height with your arm extended.

name: Forearm Rotation Band Regen
pose_description: (none)

name: Forearm Self-Massage
pose_description: Sit comfortably with your affected forearm resting on your lap or a table with the palm facing upward. Use your opposite hand to begin massage.

name: Forearm Supination Isometric Hold
pose_description: Sit with your elbow bent at 90 degrees against your torso, palm facing upward, holding a light dumbbell. Your opposite hand is positioned to provide gentle resistance.

name: Forehead Wrinkle Exercise
pose_description: Sit upright in a comfortable chair with your face relaxed and looking straight ahead. Keep your eyebrows in their natural resting position.

name: 4-7-8 Breathing Pattern
pose_description: Sit upright in a comfortable position with your spine neutral and shoulders relaxed. Rest your hands on your thighs.

name: Four-Way Ankle Resistance (with towel)
pose_description: Sit in a chair with your injured leg extended in front of you. Loop a rolled towel around the ball of your foot, holding both ends with your hands for gentle resistance.

name: Gait Training with Walking Pattern Focus
pose_description: Stand upright with good posture, feet together, ready to walk forward. Focus on maintaining balance and awareness of body position.

name: Gastrocnemius and Soleus Stretch
pose_description: Stand facing a wall with one leg extended behind you, heel planted firmly on the ground and toes pointing forward. Place your hands on the wall at shoulder height for support.

name: Gaze Stabilization Exercise
pose_description: Stand with feet hip-width apart and hold a target (finger or object) at eye level 12 inches away. Keep your head still initially.

name: Gaze Stabilization - Head Turns (VOR Exercise)
pose_description: Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart, facing a fixed target at eye level on the wall. Hold your gaze on the target with your head in neutral position.

name: Gaze Stabilization - Horizontal
pose_description: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart and focus your eyes on a fixed point at eye level. Keep your head still and relaxed.

name: Gaze Stabilization - Smooth Pursuits
pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with your head still and neck neutral. Focus your eyes on a fixed point at eye level in front of you.

name: Gaze Stabilization - Vertical
pose_description: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart and focus your eyes on a fixed point at eye level. Maintain a neutral head position.

name: Gaze Stabilization - X1 (Visual Fixation)
pose_description: Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart, facing forward with a fixed target (letter or object) at eye level on a wall about 3 feet away. Keep your head still and focus on the target.

name: Gentle Finger Flexion Exercises
pose_description: Sit comfortably with your forearm supported on a table, palm facing down. Keep your wrist in a neutral position with fingers fully extended.

name: Gentle Finger Stretching
pose_description: Sit comfortably with your affected hand resting palm-down on a table. Use your other hand to gently grasp the affected finger.

name: Gentle Finger Stretching
pose_description: Sit comfortably with one hand resting on your lap. Use your other hand to gently hold the affected finger at the base.

name: Gentle Isometric Arm Holds
pose_description: Sit upright with your affected arm bent at the elbow, held at chest height with palm facing inward. Use your other hand to support the affected arm from underneath.

name: Gentle Jaw Opening with Tongue on Palate
pose_description: Sit upright with your back against a chair and shoulders relaxed. Place your tongue on the roof of your mouth behind your upper front teeth.

name: Gentle Knee Flexion
pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Keep your back supported against the chair.

name: Gentle Neck Rolls
pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with your feet flat on the floor and shoulders relaxed. Keep your spine neutral and look straight ahead.

name: Gentle Neck Stretches
pose_description: Sit upright with shoulders relaxed and facing forward. Keep your eyes level and jaw unclenched.

name: Gentle Palm Pressing
pose_description: Sit with both hands placed flat on a table in front of you, fingers spread naturally. Keep your wrists in a neutral position.

name: Gentle Shoulder Circles
pose_description: Stand with good posture, feet shoulder-width apart, and arms hanging naturally at your sides. Keep your neck neutral and gaze forward.

name: Gentle Stretching
pose_description: Standing upright with feet shoulder-width apart. Both arms are raised straight overhead with fingers interlaced, palms facing the ceiling, stretching tall. Wearing a gray t-shirt and dark shorts. White background.

name: Gentle Wrist Extension Strengthening
pose_description: Sit with your forearm resting on a table or armrest, palm facing down with your hand hanging slightly off the edge. Keep your elbow supported and bent at 90 degrees.

name: Gentle Wrist Flexion Strengthening
pose_description: Sit with your forearm resting on a table or armrest, palm facing up with your hand hanging slightly off the edge. Keep your elbow bent at 90 degrees and supported.

name: Gentle Wrist Flexion Stretch
pose_description: Sit comfortably with your affected arm extended in front of you, palm facing upward. Your opposite hand is positioned to gently assist the stretch.

name: Glute Bridge
pose_description: Lying flat on back with knees bent at approximately 90 degrees, feet flat on the floor hip-width apart, arms resting at sides with palms down. The hips press upward by squeezing the glutes until the body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees. The weight is driven through the heels, and the core remains engaged at the top.

name: Glute Bridge Hold
pose_description: Lying flat on back with knees bent at approximately 90 degrees, feet flat on the floor hip-width apart, arms at sides. The hips are pressed upward into the bridge position, forming a straight line from shoulders to knees, and this position is sustained for the prescribed duration. The glutes remain fully contracted, the core is braced, and the hips do not drop throughout the hold.

name: Glute Bridge with Pelvic Floor Engagement
pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart, arms at your sides. Engage your core and prepare to activate your pelvic floor.

name: Glute Bridge with Pelvic Floor Squeeze
pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor hip-width apart, and arms at your sides with palms down. Position feet about 12 inches from your buttocks.

name: Glute Bridge Single Leg Regen
pose_description: (none)

name: Glute Bridge with Isometric Hold
pose_description: Lying flat on back with knees bent at approximately 90 degrees, feet flat on the floor hip-width apart, arms at sides. The hips are lifted to the top position forming a straight line from shoulders to knees, and this position is held isometrically for a sustained duration. The glutes are maximally squeezed, the core is braced, and the hips do not drop.

name: Glute Bridges
pose_description: Lying flat on back with knees bent at approximately 90 degrees, feet flat on the floor hip-width apart, arms resting at sides. Hips are lifted high off the ground forming a straight line from shoulders to knees, with glutes fully squeezed at the top.

name: Glute Bridges with Hold
pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor hip-width apart. Place arms at sides with palms down for stability.

name: Glute Squeezes
pose_description: Lie on your back with both knees bent and feet flat on the floor, positioned about hip-width apart. Keep your arms relaxed at your sides.

name: Gluteal Sets
pose_description: Lie flat on your back with both knees bent and feet flat on the floor hip-width apart. Keep your arms at your sides with palms down.

name: Goblet Squat
pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell vertically at chest level with both hands. Your spine is neutral and shoulders are back.

name: Goblet Squats
pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding one dumbbell vertically at chest height with both hands. Keep your chest upright and core engaged.

name: Grip Relaxation Technique
pose_description: Sit upright with your arms resting on a table in front of you. Make a gentle fist with both hands, lightly squeezing your fingers into your palms.

name: Grip Strength Training with Adjustable Gripper
pose_description: Sit upright with your arm relaxed at your side, holding an adjustable hand gripper in your right hand in the open position. Your fingers are extended.

name: Grip Strengthening
pose_description: Standing or seated with the arm at the side or supported on a surface. The hand squeezes a grip strengthener, stress ball, or tennis ball, closing all fingers firmly around the object with maximum contraction. The wrist remains in a neutral position, and the forearm muscles visibly contract during the squeeze.

name: Grip Strengthening Progressive
pose_description: Sit upright holding a soft stress ball or therapy putty in your affected hand with fingers extended. Your hand should be relaxed and ready to engage.

name: Grip Strengthening with Soft Object
pose_description: Sit comfortably with your forearm resting on a table or your lap, holding a soft sponge, stress ball, or towel in your hand. Your hand is in a relaxed open position.

name: Grip Strengthening with Therapy Putty
pose_description: Sit with your elbow flexed to 90 degrees and hold a ball of therapy putty in your palm. Keep your fingers extended over the putty.

name: Half-Kneeling Ankle Mobility Stretch
pose_description: Assume a half-kneeling position with one foot forward and hands on the ground. The forward foot should be flat on the ground with knee bent at 90 degrees.

name: Half-Kneeling Landmine Press
pose_description: Kneel with your right knee down and left foot forward in a half-kneeling position, facing the landmine. Hold the landmine bar at shoulder height with both hands.

name: Half-Kneeling Pallof Press
pose_description: In a half-kneeling position with the inside knee down and the outside foot forward, positioned perpendicular to a cable or band anchor point. Both hands hold the band or cable handle at the chest. The arms press straight forward, extending fully away from the chest, resisting the rotational pull of the band. The torso remains perfectly upright and square, the core braces against rotation.

name: Hamstring Curls
pose_description: Standing upright holding onto a chair or counter for balance. One foot is lifted behind the body by bending the knee, bringing the heel toward the buttock while keeping the thighs parallel. The standing leg remains straight with a slight knee bend, and the torso stays upright.

name: Hamstring Curls on Machine
pose_description: Lie face down on the hamstring curl machine with your knees just below the pad edge and ankles under the lever. Your hips should be flat against the bench.

name: Hamstring Curls (Prone)
pose_description: Lie face down on a bench or the floor with your legs extended straight behind you. Keep your hips and core engaged against the floor.

name: Hamstring Sets
pose_description: Lie on your back with both legs extended on the floor. Keep your affected leg relaxed.

name: Hamstring Stretch
pose_description: Lie on your back with one leg extended on the floor and loop a resistance band around the foot of the opposite leg. Keep that leg straight.

name: Hamstring Stretch Forward Fold
pose_description: Stand with feet hip-width apart, knees slightly bent, and arms at your sides. Maintain a neutral spine.

name: Hamstring Stretch With Band Regen
pose_description: (none)

name: Hamstring Stretch with Strap
pose_description: Lying flat on back with one leg extended on the floor. A strap, towel, or belt is looped around the foot of the other leg, which is raised straight up toward the ceiling with the knee as straight as possible. Both hands hold the ends of the strap and gently pull the leg closer, deepening the hamstring stretch. The hips remain flat on the floor.

name: Hamstring Stretches
pose_description: Lie on your back with both legs extended on the floor. Keep your unaffected leg flat and relaxed.

name: Hamstring Stretching
pose_description: Lie on your back with one leg extended on the floor and the other knee bent with foot flat. Use a strap, towel, or your hands around the bent knee's thigh.

name: Hand and Finger Dexterity Drills
pose_description: Sit comfortably with your hands resting in your lap or on a table. Your fingers are relaxed and slightly spread apart.

name: Gentle Hand Opening and Closing
pose_description: Sit comfortably with your affected arm resting on a table or in your lap. Make a gentle fist with your hand, keeping tension minimal.

name: Gentle Hand and Wrist Circles
pose_description: Stand with arms extended in front of you at shoulder height with palms facing down. Keep your elbows straight but not locked.

name: Happy Baby Pose
pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent toward your chest and feet off the ground. Grasp the outer edges of your feet with your hands.

name: Happy Baby Stretch
pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Bring one or both knees toward your chest, grasping the shins or behind the thighs.

name: Head Turns with Fixed Gaze
pose_description: Sit upright with your head in a neutral position and your eyes focused on a fixed point at eye level. Keep your shoulders relaxed and facing forward.

name: Heel Drops
pose_description: Stand upright, holding a railing for balance. Position the balls of both feet on the edge of an elevated step, allowing the heels to extend freely off the back. Slightly raise both heels so you are standing on the balls of your feet, ready to begin the exercise.

name: Heel Raises
pose_description: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart and place your hands on a sturdy counter or wall for light balance support. Keep your spine neutral and core engaged.

name: Heel Raises - Supported
pose_description: Stand upright facing a wall or counter with your hands lightly resting on it for balance. Your feet are hip-width apart.

name: Heel Slides
pose_description: Lying flat on back, viewed from the side. One leg is straight on the ground. The other knee is bent with the foot flat on the floor near the buttocks, heel touching the ground. Arms at sides.

name: Heel-to-Toe Walking
pose_description: Stand upright with arms extended to the sides for balance or lightly touching a wall. Look ahead and maintain good posture.

name: Heel-Toe Raises
pose_description: Stand with feet hip-width apart near a wall or counter for light support. Keep your posture upright and hands available to lightly touch the support if needed.

name: Heel-Toe Taps
pose_description: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart and arms at your sides or on a countertop for light support. Look straight ahead.

name: Heel-Toe Walking
pose_description: Stand upright with feet together and arms relaxed at your sides. Maintain a tall posture with your gaze directed forward.

name: Heel Walks
pose_description: Stand upright with arms at your sides or hands on a railing for light balance support. Lift your toes off the ground so your weight is on your heels.

name: Hip Abduction Exercises
pose_description: Lie on your side with the bottom leg bent for support and the top leg straight and aligned with your body. Rest your head on your arm comfortably.

name: Hip Abduction Lying
pose_description: Lie on your unaffected side with your body in a straight line and hips stacked. Keep your head resting on your lower arm for comfort.

name: Standing Hip Abduction with Rail Support
pose_description: Stand sideways next to a gym railing with the near hand holding it lightly for balance. Feet are hip-width apart with weight on the standing leg.

name: Hip Bridges
pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, positioned hip-width apart and close to your buttocks. Arms are at your sides.

name: Hip Circles
pose_description: Standing upright with hands on hips and feet shoulder-width apart. The hips draw large, smooth circles in a clockwise or counterclockwise direction, rotating through flexion, lateral tilt, extension, and the opposite lateral tilt. The upper body remains as still as possible and the knees stay slightly soft.

name: Hip Flexor Stretch
pose_description: In a half-kneeling lunge position with the right knee on the floor directly under the right hip, and the left foot flat on the floor in front with the left knee bent at 90 degrees. The torso is tall and upright, hips are pressed gently forward, and a deep stretch is felt in the front of the right hip and thigh. Hands rest on the front knee or at the waist.

name: Hip Flexor Stretch Low Lunge
pose_description: Kneel on one knee with the other foot stepped forward, hands resting on the front thigh. Keep your torso upright.

name: Hip Flexor Stretches
pose_description: Kneel on one knee with the other leg stepped forward, foot flat on the ground. Keep your torso upright.

name: Hip Hinge
pose_description: Standing upright with feet hip-width apart and knees slightly bent. The torso hinges forward from the hips, pushing the buttocks backward while keeping the back flat and chest proud. The arms hang naturally or a dowel rod is held along the spine to maintain spinal alignment. The movement stops when the torso reaches approximately parallel to the floor.

name: Horizontal Head Turns with Focus
pose_description: Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart and arms at your sides. Fix your gaze on a target object at eye level directly in front of you.

name: Inchworms
pose_description: Stand with feet hip-width apart and arms at your sides. Bend forward at the waist with a slight knee bend.

name: Internal Rotation Regen
pose_description: (none)

name: Intrinsic Hand Strengthening - Finger Flexion
pose_description: Sit upright with your forearm supported on a table, palm facing up with fingers extended. Your wrist is in neutral position with the repaired hand relaxed.

name: Intrinsic Foot Muscle Strengthening
pose_description: Sit upright with bare feet flat on the floor, toes relaxed and spread naturally. Keep your heel in place throughout the exercise.

name: Intrinsic Hand Muscle Activation
pose_description: Sit with your hand relaxed on a table, fingers extended and slightly spread. Keep your metacarpophalangeal (MCP) joints straight while preparing to curl the other joints.

name: Intrinsic Hand Strengthening
pose_description: Sit with your forearm supported on a table, hand open with fingers spread apart and relaxed. Keep your palm and wrist in a neutral position.

name: Inversion and Eversion Strengthening
pose_description: Sit upright with one leg extended and a resistance band looped around your forefoot. Hold both ends of the band.

name: Isolated Finger Extension
pose_description: Sit with your forearm supported on a table, hand relaxed in a loose fist. Keep the affected finger gently curled.

name: Isolated Finger Lifts
pose_description: Place your hand flat on a table with all fingers extended and relaxed. Keep your palm and other fingers in contact with the table surface.

name: Isometric Achilles Contraction
pose_description: Sit with your leg extended and loop a resistance band around the ball of your foot, holding the band firmly. Keep your knee straight.

name: Isometric Cervical Extension
pose_description: Standing or seated upright with one or both hands clasped behind the head. The head pushes backward into the hands with sustained effort while the hands resist the movement, creating an isometric contraction of the neck extensors. No visible movement occurs, the spine remains tall, and the eyes look straight ahead.

name: Isometric Cervical Flexion
pose_description: Standing or seated upright with one hand placed on the forehead. The head pushes forward into the hand with sustained effort while the hand resists the movement, creating an isometric contraction of the deep neck flexors. No visible movement occurs, the spine remains tall, and the chin stays level.

name: Isometric Elbow Flexion
pose_description: Sit with your affected elbow bent at approximately 90 degrees, tucked against your body. Place your opposite hand against your affected forearm for resistance.

name: Isometric Jaw Clenching
pose_description: Sit upright with your mouth closed in a relaxed position and your teeth slightly apart. Keep your shoulders and neck relaxed.

name: Isometric Quad Contraction
pose_description: Lying flat on back with a small rolled towel or bolster placed under one knee. The knee presses downward into the towel, tightening the quadriceps and lifting the heel slightly off the floor. The contraction is held isometrically, the ankle is dorsiflexed, and the opposite leg rests extended on the floor.

name: Isometric Shoulder Activation
pose_description: Stand with your arms at your sides and elbows bent to 90 degrees, forearms pointing forward. Place your other hand against the palm of your affected arm.

name: Isometric Shoulder External Rotation Regen
pose_description: (none)

name: Isometric Shoulder Internal Rotation Regen
pose_description: (none)

name: Isometric Thumb Abduction
pose_description: Sit upright with your forearm resting on a table, palm facing up. Your thumb is extended away from your fingers in a relaxed position.

name: Isometric Thumb Abduction Hold
pose_description: Sit upright with your hand relaxed on a table, thumb abducted away from your fingers at a 45-degree angle. A resistance band provides light pressure against your thumb.

name: Isometric Wrist Hold
pose_description: Sit with your forearm resting on a table, hand hanging slightly off the edge, palm facing down in a neutral position. Your opposite hand is ready to provide gentle resistance.

name: Jaw Relaxation and Gentle Opening
pose_description: Sit upright with shoulders relaxed and spine neutral. Allow your mouth to close gently with teeth slightly apart.

name: Jump Squats
pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart in an athletic stance. Your arms are at your sides and core is engaged.

name: Kegel Exercise (Pelvic Floor Contraction)
pose_description: Sit comfortably on a chair or mat with feet flat on the floor and knees bent at 90 degrees. Relax your pelvic floor muscles completely.

name: Knee Extension and Hold
pose_description: Sit in a firm chair with your back against the backrest and feet flat on the floor. Keep your affected knee bent at approximately 90 degrees.

name: Knee Flexion and Extension
pose_description: Sit in a sturdy chair with your back against the backrest and both feet flat on the floor. Keep your torso upright and relaxed.

name: Knee Flexion ROM
pose_description: Seated on the edge of a chair with the working foot on the floor. The heel slides backward under the chair, bending the knee as far as comfortably possible to increase range of motion. The opposite foot remains flat on the floor, and the hands may rest on the thighs or grip the chair seat for stability.

name: Knee Flexion Stretch
pose_description: Lie on your back with both legs extended on the floor. Keep your back flat and relaxed against the ground.

name: Knee to Chest Hold
pose_description: Lie on your back with both legs extended on the floor. Keep your head and shoulders relaxed.

name: Knee-to-Chest Stretch
pose_description: Lying flat on back with one knee pulled up toward the chest, both hands clasping below the kneecap or behind the thigh. The opposite leg remains extended flat on the floor. The lower back relaxes and rounds gently into the floor, and the head and shoulders remain on the ground.

name: Lat Pulldown Machine
pose_description: Sit at the machine with thighs under the pad and feet flat on the floor. Reach up and grip the wide bar with hands slightly wider than shoulder-width.

name: Lat Stretches
pose_description: Standing upright, the figure reaches one arm overhead and leans to the opposite side, creating a long stretch along the side of the torso from hip to fingertips. The other arm hangs naturally at the side. Feet are shoulder-width apart with a slight lateral bend in the torso.

name: Lateral Jaw Glide Exercise
pose_description: Sit upright with your mouth closed and teeth lightly touching in neutral position. Place your index finger on your chin for guidance.

name: Lateral Jaw Movement
pose_description: Sit upright with your mouth slightly open, about a quarter-inch, in a relaxed neutral position. Keep your head still and stable.

name: Lateral Lunge with Reach
pose_description: The figure takes a wide step to one side, bending that knee while keeping the other leg straight. The torso leans slightly forward and the opposite arm reaches toward the bent knee foot. The straight leg inner thigh is stretched. Weight is on the bent leg with the foot flat on the ground.

name: Lateral Lunges
pose_description: Stand upright with feet together, holding dumbbells at your sides. Engage your core with neutral spine alignment.

name: Lateral Neck Stretch
pose_description: Sit upright with shoulders relaxed and spine neutral. Keep your gaze forward with both feet flat on the floor.

name: Lateral Side Lying Clam Shell Regen
pose_description: (none)

name: Lateral Step-Ups
pose_description: Begin by standing tall beside a low step or platform, with the working leg positioned closest to the step. Place the entire sole of the working foot flat onto the center of the step, keeping the non-working foot on the floor beside it, with your body facing forward and shoulders square.

name: Leg Press Machine
pose_description: Sit in the machine with back and head resting against the support pad and feet on the platform shoulder-width apart. Knees should be at approximately 90 degrees.

name: Leg Swings Forward and Back
pose_description: Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend, holding onto a stable surface for balance. Keep your torso upright and engage your core.

name: Levator Scapulae Stretch
pose_description: Standing upright with feet shoulder-width apart. The head is rotated approximately 45 degrees TO THE LEFT and the chin is tucked downward toward the LEFT armpit, creating a diagonal downward gaze toward the left. The LEFT hand reaches up over the head and rests on the right side of the skull, gently pulling the head further down and to the LEFT. The right shoulder is pressed downward and the right arm hangs relaxed at the side. A stretch is felt along the right side of the back of the neck.

name: Lightweight Lateral Raises
pose_description: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, holding light dumbbells at your sides with a neutral grip. Engage your core and keep shoulders down.

name: Lip Pucker and Stretch
pose_description: Sit facing a mirror with a neutral facial expression and relaxed lips. Keep your head still and your shoulders down.

name: Lip Rounding Exercise
pose_description: Sit upright with your mouth relaxed and lips in a neutral position. Your face should be calm with no tension in the perioral muscles.

name: Long Arc Quads
pose_description: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and hips flexed to 90 degrees, so your shins are parallel to the floor. Your arms should rest relaxed by your sides.

name: Lower Back Release Roll
pose_description: Lying on back with a foam roller positioned horizontally under the lower back just above the pelvis. Knees are bent with feet flat on the floor. The body gently rolls the foam roller up and down over the lumbar muscles by bending and straightening the legs, applying moderate pressure. Hands may be behind the head or crossed on the chest.

name: Intrinsic Hand Muscle Activation (Lumbrical Exercise)
pose_description: Sit with your forearm supported on a table, hand open and relaxed with fingers extended. Position your hand in a neutral posture with the palm facing sideways.

name: Lying Figure Four Stretch
pose_description: Lie on your back with both knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Cross one ankle over the opposite knee to form a figure-four shape.

name: Lying Hip Flexor Stretch
pose_description: Lying on back at the edge of a bed or table with both knees pulled to the chest. One knee remains hugged to the chest while the other leg lowers off the edge, hanging down toward the floor with the knee slightly bent. Gravity pulls the lowered thigh into extension, stretching the hip flexors and front of the thigh. The lower back stays flat on the surface.

name: Lying Lateral Leg Lifts
pose_description: Lie on your side with your bottom leg bent for support and top leg extended straight. Keep your hips stacked and engage your pelvic floor.

name: Lymphatic Drainage Arm Raises
pose_description: Stand upright with your arms at your sides, keeping your shoulders relaxed and your core engaged. This is a gentle, controlled movement focused on promoting lymphatic flow.

name: Marble Pickup
pose_description: Seated in a chair with one foot bare and marbles or small objects scattered on the floor. The toes grip and pick up individual marbles, transferring them to a cup or different location. The heel remains on the floor, and the foot flexors work to curl the toes around each marble.

name: Marble Pickups
pose_description: Sit in a chair with bare feet on the floor. Place 5-10 marbles or small objects on the floor in front of you.

name: Marching in Place with High Knees
pose_description: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, arms bent at 90 degrees ready to swing. Maintain an engaged core and neutral spine.

name: Marching in Place
pose_description: Stand upright with feet together, arms at your sides, and maintain good posture. Engage your core and prepare to lift your knees.

name: Median Nerve Glide
pose_description: Standing upright with the affected arm extended out to the side at shoulder height. Starting with the wrist flexed and fingers curled toward the palm, the wrist gradually extends and the fingers straighten while the head tilts away from the outstretched arm. The movement alternates fluidly between the tensioned and relaxed positions to glide the median nerve.

name: Median Nerve Gliding
pose_description: Sit with your right arm at your side, elbow bent 90 degrees, palm facing inward. Keep your shoulder relaxed and your neck neutral.

name: Mini Squats
pose_description: Standing upright with feet shoulder-width apart. The hips push back and the knees bend to approximately 30 to 45 degrees in a partial squat, as if beginning to sit in a tall chair. Arms extend forward for counterbalance, the chest stays lifted, and the knees track over the toes without caving inward.

name: Modified Plank Hold
pose_description: Begin on your forearms and knees with elbows under shoulders and knees under hips. Keep your neck neutral and core engaged.

name: Modified Superman Hold
pose_description: Lie face down on the floor with your forehead resting on a rolled towel and arms at your sides. Keep your legs straight and relaxed on the ground.

name: Modified Wall Push-ups
pose_description: Stand arm's length away from a wall with feet hip-width apart. Place both palms flat against the wall at shoulder height.

name: Monster Walk
pose_description: Stand upright with a resistance band looped around your legs just above your knees, feet hip-width apart. Maintain a slight knee bend and neutral spine throughout the movement.

name: Monster Walks
pose_description: Standing in a quarter-squat position with a resistance band looped around the ankles or just above the knees. Feet are shoulder-width apart, knees slightly bent, and the torso is slightly hinged forward at the hips. Steps are taken diagonally forward and outward, maintaining tension on the band throughout, like a monster walking.

name: Mouth Opening Exercise
pose_description: Sit upright with your mouth gently closed and face relaxed. Keep your jaw in a neutral position without tension.

name: Neck Flexion and Extension
pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat and shoulders relaxed. Keep your eyes forward and spine neutral.

name: Neck Flexor Release
pose_description: Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart and shoulders relaxed. Place one hand gently on top of your head near the opposite ear.

name: Neck Flexor Stretch
pose_description: Sit upright with good posture and shoulders relaxed. Head is in neutral position.

name: Neck Isometric Hold - Affected Side
pose_description: Sit upright with shoulders relaxed and spine neutral. Place your hand against the side of your head on the affected side (the side the chin is rotated toward).

name: Neck Isometric Hold
pose_description: Sit upright with perfect posture and place your hand against one side of your head. Your neck is in a neutral position.

name: Neck Isometric Hold - Lateral
pose_description: Sit upright with good posture and place your right hand against the right side of your head near your temple. Your head is in a neutral position.

name: Neck Isometric Holds
pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with good posture and your hands placed against the side of your head. Your neck is in a neutral position looking straight ahead.

name: Neck Lateral Flexion
pose_description: Sit upright with shoulders relaxed and head in neutral position. Keep both feet flat on the floor.

name: Neck Lateral Flexion Stretch
pose_description: Sit upright with both feet flat on the floor and shoulders relaxed. Your head is in neutral position facing forward.

name: Neck Retraction
pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with shoulders relaxed and eyes facing forward. Keep your chin level and parallel to the ground.

name: Neck ROM - Gentle Turns
pose_description: Sit upright with good posture, shoulders relaxed, and head facing forward. Keep your shoulders still throughout the movement.

name: Neck Rotations
pose_description: Stand tall with the feet hip-width apart and arms relaxed at the sides. Keep the shoulders level and relaxed, with the head held in a neutral position, gazing straight forward.

name: Neck and Shoulder Relaxation
pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with good posture. Keep your shoulders relaxed and your arms resting in your lap.

name: Neck and Shoulder Stretch
pose_description: Sit upright with your back straight and shoulders relaxed. Keep your chin level and looking forward.

name: Neck Side Bends
pose_description: Standing or seated upright with the spine tall and shoulders relaxed. The head tilts to one side, bringing the ear toward the shoulder while the opposite shoulder remains depressed. One hand may gently assist the stretch by resting on top of the head. The face continues to point straight ahead without rotation.

name: Neck Stretch Gentle Rotation Regen
pose_description: (none)

name: Neck Stretching - Sternocleidomastoid
pose_description: Sit upright with good posture and shoulders relaxed. Keep your chin level and face forward.

name: Nose Wrinkle Exercise
pose_description: Sit upright facing a mirror with a neutral expression and your nose in a relaxed position. Keep your head still and shoulders down.

name: Open Book Stretch
pose_description: Lying on one side with hips and knees bent to approximately 90 degrees stacked on top of each other. Both arms start extended in front at shoulder height, palms together. The top arm opens upward and rotates across the body like a book opening, reaching toward the floor on the opposite side while the knees remain stacked. The gaze follows the moving hand, creating a deep thoracic rotation.

name: Overhead Shoulder Press
pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding dumbbells at shoulder height with elbows bent at 90 degrees. Your core is engaged and your spine is neutral.

name: Overhead Tricep Stretch
pose_description: Standing upright with one arm raised overhead and the elbow bent, dropping the hand behind the head and between the shoulder blades. The opposite hand gently pushes the elbow further behind the head, deepening the stretch along the back of the upper arm. The torso remains tall and the head stays in a neutral position.

name: Pallof Press
pose_description: Standing perpendicular to a cable machine or band anchor point with feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent. Both hands hold the handle or band at the center of the chest. The arms press straight forward, extending fully, resisting the rotational pull of the band. The core is fully braced, the hips remain square, and the torso does not rotate.

name: Palmar Fascia Stretching
pose_description: Sit upright and use your opposite hand to gently grasp the affected hand at the base of the fingers. Your hand should be relaxed and supported.

name: Passive Elbow Flexion Stretch
pose_description: Sit upright with your right arm extended straight out in front of you at shoulder height, palm facing down. Use your left hand to gently grasp your right wrist or forearm.

name: Passive Finger Range of Motion
pose_description: Sit with your affected hand supported on a table, palm facing down. Use your other hand to support under the affected finger.

name: Patellar Tendon Mobilization
pose_description: Sit with one leg extended and use your hands to gently grasp the area just below your kneecap. Keep the quad relaxed and the knee slightly bent.

name: Patellar Tendon Strap Exercises
pose_description: Sit on a chair with one leg extended and a resistance band wrapped around the upper calf just below the knee. Keep good posture and core engaged.

name: Patellar Tendon Stretches
pose_description: Kneel on a soft mat with your toes tucked under and hips positioned over your knees. Place hands on the floor in front of you for light support.

name: Pec Stretch
pose_description: Standing beside a doorframe or wall. One arm is placed against the surface with the elbow bent at 90 degrees at shoulder height. The body rotates away from the anchored arm, opening the chest until a stretch is felt across the pectoral muscle and front of the shoulder. The feet are staggered for stability.

name: Pectoralis Minor Stretch
pose_description: Stand facing a wall or doorway with one arm raised at shoulder height, elbow bent to 90 degrees. Place your forearm against the wall or doorframe.

name: Pelvic Floor Activation
pose_description: Sit comfortably in a chair with feet flat on the ground and spine in neutral position. Relax all muscles and take a deep breath.

name: Pelvic Floor Muscle Contractions (Kegels)
pose_description: Sit comfortably in a chair with feet flat on the floor, maintaining neutral spine posture. Relax all abdominal and leg muscles.

name: Pelvic Floor Activation - Kegel Exercise
pose_description: Sit upright in a comfortable position with feet flat on the floor. Relax all muscles and take a deep breath to center yourself.

name: Pelvic Floor Relaxation Breathing
pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Place one hand on your chest and one on your lower abdomen.

name: Pelvic Tilts
pose_description: Lying flat on back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor hip-width apart. The lower back is gently pressed into the floor by engaging the abdominal muscles and tilting the pelvis posteriorly, flattening the natural lumbar curve. Arms rest at sides and shoulders remain relaxed on the floor.

name: Pendulum Circles
pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and lean forward slightly, supporting your body with your uninvolved arm on a table or chair. Let your affected arm hang straight down toward the floor in a relaxed position.

name: Pendulum Shoulder Circles
pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and bend forward at the hips so your torso is nearly parallel to the ground, supporting yourself with your unaffected arm on a table or chair. Let your affected arm hang freely downward in a relaxed position.

name: Pendulum Swings
pose_description: Standing with feet shoulder-width apart, bending forward at the waist approximately 45 to 60 degrees. The non-working arm rests on a table or chair for support. The affected arm hangs straight down like a pendulum and swings gently in small circles or back and forth, completely relaxed with no active muscle contraction.

name: Pigeon Pose
pose_description: Start on your hands and knees, facing forward. Position your hands directly under your shoulders and your knees directly under your hips, with your shins parallel to each other and your feet pointing straight back.

name: Pigeon Pose Hip Stretch
pose_description: Start on all fours, then bring your right knee forward between your hands with your right foot flexed. Keep your left leg extended straight behind you with your hip square to the ground.

name: Pigeon Pose Stretch
pose_description: Start on a mat in a modified hands-and-knees position. Your hands are under your shoulders, your right knee is bent and brought forward towards your right hand, with your right shin angled across your body and your right foot near your left hip. Your left leg is extended straight back behind you, with the top of your left foot on the mat.

name: PIP Joint Extension Isometric Hold
pose_description: Sit comfortably with your forearm resting on a table, palm facing down. Place your affected finger in a slightly flexed position with the PIP joint bent at approximately 30 degrees.

name: PIP Joint Isolation Flexion
pose_description: Sit with your forearm supported on a table with palm facing down. Keep the metacarpophalangeal (MCP) joints straight while allowing only the proximal interphalangeal (PIP) joints to flex.

name: PIP Joint Passive Range of Motion
pose_description: Sit with your affected hand resting on a table, palm up. Use your other hand to gently support the finger at the base.

name: Piriformis Stretch
pose_description: Clean fitness illustration style on a plain white background. Seated on the floor with both knees bent and feet flat on the floor in front. The LEFT ankle is crossed over the RIGHT thigh just above the knee, allowing the LEFT knee to gently fall outward. The torso is upright with the back straight, hands resting flat on the floor behind the hips for support. A mild stretch is felt in the left glute and outer hip.

name: Plank
pose_description: Body supported on forearms and toes in a straight line from head to heels. Elbows directly under shoulders, forearms flat on floor, core tight, hips level — not sagging or piking.

name: Planks with Scapular Control
pose_description: Begin in a forearm plank position with elbows under shoulders and forearms parallel. Keep your core tight and body in one straight line from head to heels.

name: Planks with Shoulder Taps
pose_description: Hold a plank position with hands directly under your shoulders, body in a straight line, and core fully engaged. Keep your hips stable and avoid rotating.

name: Plantar Fascia Self-Massage
pose_description: Sit in a chair with one foot flat on the floor. Place a small ball or roller under the arch of your foot.

name: Plantar Fascia Rolling
pose_description: Sit upright and place one foot flat on the floor with the opposite leg crossed over it. Grip your forefoot with both hands positioned on either side of the arch.

name: Plantar Fascia Stretch
pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with one leg crossed over the opposite knee. Your foot is elevated and accessible for hand manipulation.

name: Plantar Fascia Stretching with Towel
pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with one leg extended in front of you or draped over your knee. Keep your back straight against the chair.

name: Posterior Chain Activation
pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor hip-width apart, and arms at your sides with palms down. Keep your head neutral on the floor.

name: Posterior Elbow Stretch
pose_description: Stand upright and place your affected arm behind your back with elbow bent. Your opposite hand gently holds your affected elbow or forearm.

name: Posterior Shoulder Doorway Stretch
pose_description: Stand in a doorway with your affected arm raised and forearm against the doorframe at 90 degrees. Position your elbow at shoulder height with your palm facing forward.

name: Posterior Shoulder Stretch
pose_description: Stand upright with your feet shoulder-width apart and your right arm crossed horizontally across your chest at shoulder height. Your right elbow should be slightly bent.

name: Posterior Shoulder Stretch Band Regen
pose_description: (none)

name: Postural Correction Hold
pose_description: Stand with feet hip-width apart, chest lifted, and shoulders back and down. Engage your core muscles as if bracing for impact.

name: Postural Neck Stretch
pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with your shoulders relaxed and your back supported against the chair. Look straight ahead.

name: Postural Wall Hold
pose_description: Stand with your back against a wall with heels, glutes, and shoulders all touching the wall. Your neck should be in neutral alignment with your head also touching the wall.

name: Prayer Stretch
pose_description: Kneeling on the floor with knees together and shins flat. The hips are sitting back lightly on the heels, the torso is folded forward over the thighs, and the chest hovers just above the thighs. The arms extend forward on the floor at approximately shoulder width with palms down, elbows slightly off the floor. The forehead floats just above the floor. A gentle initial stretch is felt through the lats and shoulders.

name: Progressive Muscle Relaxation
pose_description: Lie flat on your back with legs extended and arms at your sides, palms facing up. Keep your neck neutral and shoulders relaxed away from your ears.

name: Pronation and Supination
pose_description: Sit upright with your elbow bent at 90 degrees and held against your side, palm facing down (pronated position). Keep your upper arm stable and only rotate at the forearm.

name: Pronation and Supination Strengthening
pose_description: Sit with your elbow bent at 90 degrees, tucked against your body with your palm facing down. Imagine holding a hammer with your hand at a neutral position.

name: Prone Back Extension
pose_description: Lie face down with your forehead resting on a small towel and arms at your sides with palms down. Keep your legs straight and relaxed with toes pointed.

name: Prone Cobra
pose_description: Lie face down on the floor with your legs straight and the tops of your feet resting on the ground. Position your arms alongside your torso with your palms facing down and your head relaxed, looking towards the floor.

name: Prone Cobra Breathing
pose_description: Lie face down with your forehead resting on the back of your hands, elbows tucked close to your body. Keep your legs extended and relaxed.

name: Prone Cobra Hold
pose_description: Lie face-down on a mat with your palms flat under your shoulders and legs extended behind you. Your forehead is gently resting on the mat.

name: Prone Cobras
pose_description: Lie face down with your forearms on the ground, elbows positioned under your shoulders, and legs extended behind you. Keep your neck neutral and eyes looking down.

name: Prone External Rotation Regen
pose_description: (none)

name: Prone Gastrocnemius Stretch
pose_description: Lie face down on a mat, supporting your upper body on your forearms with your elbows directly under your shoulders. Extend both legs straight back, keeping your knees fully extended and your feet in a neutral, relaxed position.

name: Prone Glute Squeeze Holds
pose_description: Lying face down with legs extended straight and arms at sides or folded under the forehead. Both glute muscles are maximally squeezed together and held in a sustained isometric contraction. The legs remain on the floor, the hips press gently into the floor, and the contraction is held for several seconds before releasing.

name: Prone Hamstring Curl
pose_description: Lying face down with legs extended straight and arms folded under the chin. One heel curls toward the buttock by bending the knee against resistance from an ankle weight or band. The hips remain pressed into the floor, the thigh does not lift, and the movement is controlled in both the curling and lowering phases.

name: Prone Hamstring Isometric Hold
pose_description: Lie face down on a firm surface with legs extended straight behind you. Place your forehead on your hands for comfort and support.

name: Prone Hand Elevation and Relaxation
pose_description: Lie face down on a bed or firm surface with pillows under your chest and affected arm resting below heart level. Keep your head turned to one side in a comfortable position.

name: Prone Head Turns
pose_description: Lie face down on a firm surface with your forehead resting on a small rolled towel or pillow. Keep your arms relaxed alongside your body.

name: Prone Hip Abduction
pose_description: Lie face-down on a bed or mat with a pillow under your hips for comfort and support. Keep your arms relaxed and your surgical leg extended straight.

name: Prone Hip Adduction Lifts
pose_description: Lie face down with a resistance band looped around both legs above the knees. Rest your forehead on your hands and keep legs together initially.

name: Prone Hip Bridges
pose_description: Lie face down with forearms on the ground, elbows under shoulders, and legs extended with toes tucked under. Engage your core and glutes to stabilize your lower back.

name: Prone Hip Extension
pose_description: Lying face down with legs extended straight and arms folded under the chin or at sides. One leg lifts straight off the floor behind the body, squeezing the glute to drive the movement, while the knee remains straight. The hips and pelvis stay pressed into the floor, and the leg lifts to approximately 15 to 20 degrees.

name: Prone Hip Extension Pulse
