pose_description: Lying face down with legs extended straight and arms folded under the chin. One leg lifts a few inches off the floor with the knee straight, then performs small pulsing movements upward, rapidly contracting the glute at the top of each pulse. The hips remain pressed into the floor and the leg does not touch down between pulses.

name: Prone Hip Extensions
pose_description: Lie face down on the floor with your forehead resting on your hands and legs extended straight behind you. Keep your core engaged to prevent lower back arching.

name: Prone Hip Flexor Stretch
pose_description: Lie face down with forearms on the ground, elbows under shoulders. One leg should be bent with knee toward your glute, while the other extends behind you.

name: Prone Horizontal Abduction
pose_description: Lie face down on a bench with both arms hanging off the sides, elbows slightly bent with light dumbbells in hand. Your chest should be supported by the bench.

name: Prone I-Y-T Raises
pose_description: Lying face down on the floor or a bench with arms hanging down. The exercise cycles through three arm positions: I (arms lift straight overhead in line with the body), Y (arms lift at 45 degrees forming a Y shape), and T (arms lift straight out to the sides at 90 degrees). Thumbs point up, shoulder blades squeeze together, and the forehead stays on the floor.

name: Prone I-Y-T Shoulder Activation
pose_description: Lying face down on the floor or an incline bench. The arms cycle through three positions with controlled holds: I (arms extended straight overhead close to the ears), Y (arms lifted at 45 degrees from the head), and T (arms lifted straight to the sides at 90 degrees). Thumbs point up, the shoulder blades squeeze together, and each position is held for a few seconds before transitioning.

name: Prone I-Y-T Holds
pose_description: Lie face down on a bench with your arms hanging toward the floor and your legs extended behind you. Your forehead rests on a small pad or folded towel.

name: Prone I-Y-T Raises
pose_description: Lie face down on a bench or floor with arms at your sides and forehead resting on a towel. Your legs are extended with toes on the ground for stability.

name: Prone Knee Extension
pose_description: Patient lies face-down on a mat with hips flat and arms folded under the forehead for comfort. The affected leg is bent with the knee at 90 degrees.

name: Prone Knee Flexion
pose_description: Lying face down with legs extended straight and arms at sides or folded under the forehead. One knee bends, bringing the heel toward the buttock as far as comfortably possible. The hips remain pressed flat against the floor and the thigh of the bending leg does not lift off the surface.

name: Prone Lumbar Extension Band Regen
pose_description: (none)

name: Prone Neck Isometric Hold
pose_description: Lie face down with your arms extended overhead and forehead resting on a towel. Engage your core to stabilize your spine.

name: Prone Press-Up
pose_description: Lying face down with hands positioned under the shoulders as if preparing for a push-up. The upper body presses upward by straightening the arms, lifting the chest off the floor while the hips and pelvis remain in contact with the floor. The lower back extends into a gentle arch, and the head looks forward. The arms may be fully or partially extended depending on comfort.

name: Prone Reverse Fly
pose_description: Lie face down on an incline bench or floor with light dumbbells in each hand, arms hanging down with a slight elbow bend. Keep your forehead neutral and core engaged.

name: Prone Scapular Retraction
pose_description: Lying face down with arms at sides, palms facing down toward the thighs. The shoulder blades squeeze firmly together and downward, lifting the chest slightly off the floor. The forehead may remain on the floor or lift slightly, and the arms lift a few inches off the ground as the scapulae retract. The lower body stays relaxed.

name: Prone Shoulder Blade Squeezes
pose_description: Lie face-down with your forehead on a rolled towel and arms at your sides, palms facing down. Keep your legs straight and relaxed on the ground.

name: Prone Shoulder Flexion
pose_description: Lying face down with the forehead resting on the floor and arms extended overhead on the ground. One or both arms lift straight off the floor with thumbs pointing up, raising the arm as high as possible while keeping the forehead down and the rest of the body flat. The shoulder blade retracts and depresses as the arm lifts.

name: Prone Shoulder Flexion Lifts
pose_description: Lie face-down on a bench with your chest supported, feet anchored to the floor, and arms hanging straight down holding a resistance band. Your forehead is neutral and core is engaged.

name: Prone Shoulder Horizontal Abduction
pose_description: Lying face down on a bench with the head resting on the surface and neck neutral. One arm is held horizontally out to the side, fully extended and parallel to the floor at 90 degrees of horizontal abduction (forming a T-shape with the torso when viewed from above). The arm is actively raised to shoulder level, NOT hanging down. The thumb points up, palm faces forward. The other arm rests alongside the body.

name: Prone Shoulder I-Y-T Raises
pose_description: Lie face-down with your forehead resting on a rolled towel and arms at your sides with palms facing down. Engage your core to stabilize your torso.

name: Prone Shoulder Isometric Hold
pose_description: Lie face down on a firm surface with arms at your sides, palms down, and forehead resting on a small towel. Your legs should be extended straight behind you.

name: Prone Shoulder I-Y-T
pose_description: Lie face-down on a firm surface with a small pillow under your forehead to keep your neck neutral. Let both arms rest alongside your body with palms facing down.

name: Prone Shoulder I-Y-T Raises
pose_description: Lie face down on a table or bench with your arms hanging toward the floor and thumbs pointing forward. Your forehead rests on a small towel and legs are extended straight behind you.

name: Prone Shoulder Squeeze
pose_description: Lie face down on a mat with your forehead resting on a towel and arms at your sides, palms facing down. Keep your legs extended with toes pointing down.

name: Prone Shoulder Squeeze on Pillow
pose_description: Lie face down on a bed or mat with a pillow under your chest for comfort, arms at your sides with elbows bent. Your forehead rests on a small towel roll to keep your neck neutral.

name: Prone Shoulder Stabilization
pose_description: Lie face down with arms extended overhead in a Y position, forehead resting neutrally on a towel. Engage your core to maintain neutral spine.

name: Prone Shoulder Y-T-W
pose_description: Lie face down on a bench or elevated surface with arms hanging down on either side. Rest your forehead on a towel to maintain neutral cervical spine.

name: Prone Superman Hold
pose_description: Lie face down on your stomach with arms extended overhead and legs straight. Your forehead rests on the floor in a neutral neck position.

name: Prone T Raises
pose_description: Lying face down on the floor or a bench with arms hanging down or resting on the floor. Both arms lift straight out to the sides at 90 degrees from the torso, forming a T shape, with thumbs pointing toward the ceiling. The shoulder blades squeeze firmly together and the arms lift to body height. The forehead rests on the floor.

name: Prone T-Y-I Holds
pose_description: Lie face down on a bench with your chest at the edge and feet on the ground for stability. Your arms hang toward the floor with a slight bend in the elbows.

name: Prone Thoracic Extension Hold
pose_description: Lie face down with your forehead resting on a folded towel and arms at your sides with palms facing up. Keep your legs extended and relaxed.

name: Prone Y Raises
pose_description: Lying face down on the floor or a bench with arms hanging down or resting on the floor. Both arms lift upward and outward at approximately 45 degrees from the head, forming a Y shape, with thumbs pointing toward the ceiling. The forehead rests on the floor, the shoulder blades squeeze together, and the arms lift to approximately ear height.

name: Prone YTW Raises
pose_description: Lie face down on a stability ball, supporting your chest and allowing your shoulders to clear the edge. Extend your legs behind you with feet on the ground for stability. Let your arms hang freely toward the floor, palms facing each other.

name: Proprioceptive Foot Taps on Ground
pose_description: Stand with one hand lightly touching a stable surface for balance. Weight is on one leg while the other leg is ready to perform taps.

name: Proprioceptive Head Tracking
pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart with arms at your sides. Focus on a fixed point at eye level in front of you.

name: Protective Finger Splinting Position Exercise
pose_description: Sit comfortably with your hand resting on a table in a neutral position. Your affected finger should be relaxed and in its natural position.

name: Pursed-Lip Breathing with Arm Raises
pose_description: Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart and arms at your sides. Take a slow breath in through your nose for a count of 2.

name: Pursed-Lip Breathing during Light Exercise
pose_description: Stand upright in a relaxed position with shoulders back and feet hip-width apart. Focus on your normal breathing pattern.

name: Pursed-Lip Breathing Walk
pose_description: Stand upright with good posture and feet shoulder-width apart. Begin walking at a comfortable, slow pace.

name: Quadriceps Activation with Towel Roll
pose_description: Lie on your back with a rolled towel under one knee and the other leg extended flat on the floor. Keep your arms at your sides.

name: Quad Sets
pose_description: Lying flat on back with BOTH legs fully extended straight along the ground, a small rolled towel under one knee. The quadriceps on one leg is visibly flexed and tight. Arms resting at sides, toes pointing up.

name: Quadriceps Stretch
pose_description: Stand upright on one leg with good balance, using a wall or chair for support if needed. Keep your core engaged.

name: Quad Stretches
pose_description: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, using a wall or gym equipment for balance. Bring one heel toward your glutes.

name: Quadriceps Sets
pose_description: Lie on your back with one leg extended and the other knee bent with a rolled towel underneath. Keep your lower back neutral against the floor.

name: Quadriceps Sets with Breathing Focus
pose_description: Lie on your back with legs extended, a small rolled towel under one knee. Keep the other leg relaxed on the floor.

name: Quadriceps Sets with Pelvic Floor Activation
pose_description: Lie on your back with one leg extended flat and the other knee slightly bent with foot flat on the floor. Place a small rolled towel under the extended leg's knee if needed.

name: Quadriceps Sets with VMO Focus
pose_description: Lie on your back with legs extended flat on the floor. Place a small rolled towel under the knee of the working leg.

name: Quadriceps Stretch
pose_description: Stand upright next to a wall or chair for balance, with weight evenly distributed on both feet. Look straight ahead with good posture.

name: Quadriceps Stretches
pose_description: Stand upright and use a wall or chair for balance with one hand. Stand on one leg with good posture.

name: Quadriceps Stretching
pose_description: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart and use one hand on a wall or object for balance. Bend one knee and bring your foot toward your glutes.

name: Radial and Ulnar Deviation
pose_description: Sit upright with your forearm resting on a table and your hand hanging off the edge in neutral position. Your thumb points upward.

name: Radial and Ulnar Deviation with Lightweight
pose_description: Sit with your forearm supported on a table, holding a light dumbbell in neutral grip with hand hanging off the edge. Keep your elbow stationary throughout.

name: Recumbent Figure Four
pose_description: Lie on your back with both knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Cross one ankle over the opposite knee to create a figure-four shape.

name: Relaxation Breathing with Jaw Release
pose_description: Sit upright in a comfortable chair with your shoulders relaxed and your eyes either open or gently closed. Allow your jaw to rest naturally.

name: Resistance Band Pull Apart Regen
pose_description: (none)

name: Resisted Ankle Dorsiflexion
pose_description: Seated or standing with a resistance band looped around the top of the forefoot, anchored to a fixed point in front. The foot pulls upward against the band resistance, dorsiflexing the ankle and bringing the toes toward the shin. The heel remains on the floor and the lower leg stays stationary.

name: Resisted Ankle Plantarflexion
pose_description: Seated or standing with a resistance band looped around the ball of the foot, anchored behind the body or held in the hands. The foot pushes downward against the band resistance, plantarflexing the ankle and pointing the toes. The lower leg stays stationary and the movement occurs purely at the ankle.

name: Resisted High Knee March
pose_description: Stand upright with a resistance band looped around both legs just above the knees. Maintain good posture with arms ready to swing naturally.

name: Resisted Jaw Closure
pose_description: Sit upright with your mouth slightly open. Place your index finger gently under your chin.

name: Reverse Machine Fly
pose_description: Sit upright at a reverse fly machine with your chest against the pad and feet flat on the ground. Grip the handles with a neutral grip at shoulder height.

name: Reverse Pec Deck Flyes
pose_description: Sit on a reverse pec deck machine with your chest against the pad and hands gripping the handles at shoulder height. Your shoulders are relaxed and arms are bent slightly.

name: Reverse Snow Angels
pose_description: Lie face-down on a bed or mat with arms at your sides and forehead resting on a small pillow. Keep your legs straight and relaxed.

name: Reverse Wrist Curls
pose_description: Seated or standing with the forearm resting on a table or thigh, palm facing down, holding a light dumbbell. The wrist extends upward, lifting the back of the hand toward the ceiling while the forearm remains stationary. The movement is small and controlled, targeting the wrist extensors.

name: Rowing Machine
pose_description: Sit on the rowing machine with feet secured, knees slightly bent, and arms extended forward. Grab the handle with an overhand grip at shoulder height.

name: Scalene Stretch
pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with good posture and feet flat on the floor. Keep your shoulders relaxed and your head in a neutral position.

name: Scapular Push-Up
pose_description: Start in a plank position with hands under shoulders, elbows locked, and your body in a straight line from head to heels. Your core should be engaged and your shoulder blades slightly retracted.

name: Scapular Push-ups
pose_description: Position yourself in a plank position with hands directly under your shoulders and your body in a straight line. Keep your elbows locked and core engaged.

name: Scapular Retraction Squeeze
pose_description: Sit upright with arms at your sides, shoulders relaxed. Keep your chest open and spine neutral.

name: Scapular Retractions
pose_description: Sit upright with your back against a chair or wall, arms at your sides with elbows bent at 90 degrees. Hold a resistance band with both hands, maintaining slight tension in the band.

name: Scapular Retractions with Resistance
pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with your arms extended forward at shoulder height, palms facing each other. Your core is engaged and shoulders are relaxed.

name: Scapular Squeeze
pose_description: Stand with good posture, arms at your sides with elbows bent to 90 degrees and forearms pointing forward. Keep your shoulders relaxed and away from your ears.

name: Scapular Squeeze (Prone)
pose_description: Lie face down on a firm surface with arms at your sides, palms facing down. Your forehead rests on a rolled towel to keep your neck neutral.

name: Scapular Squeezes
pose_description: A person is seated upright with good posture, maintaining a straight back. Shoulders are relaxed and positioned naturally, with arms hanging loosely at the sides. The head is in a neutral position with the chin slightly tucked.

name: Scapular Wall Slides
pose_description: Stand with your back against a wall with feet about 12 inches away, knees slightly bent. Place your arms against the wall at shoulder height with elbows bent to 90 degrees.

name: Scar Tissue Mobilization
pose_description: Sit with your forearm supported on a table, gently exposing the surgical incision site on your wrist or palm. Use your opposite hand to apply light pressure.

name: Sciatic Nerve Glide
pose_description: Lying flat on back with one hip and knee bent to 90 degrees, hands clasping behind the thigh. The knee slowly straightens, extending the foot toward the ceiling while the ankle alternates between dorsiflexion and plantarflexion to glide the sciatic nerve. The opposite leg remains flat on the floor, and the movement is smooth and pain-free.

name: Seated Achilles Stretch
pose_description: Sit on the floor with legs extended in front of you. Keep your back straight and shoulders relaxed.

name: Seated Adductor Squeeze With Band Regen
pose_description: (none)

name: Seated Ankle Alphabet
pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with one leg extended or crossed over the opposite knee. Keep your foot relaxed and ready to move.

name: Seated Ankle Circles
pose_description: Sit upright in a chair and lift one foot slightly off the ground, keeping the knee bent at a comfortable angle. Rest your hands on your lap for balance.

name: Seated Ankle Inversion and Eversion
pose_description: Sit in a chair with your injured leg extended out in front of you or resting on another chair. Keep your knee relaxed and your foot in a neutral position.

name: Seated Ankle Pumps
pose_description: Seated in a chair or on a bed with legs extended in front or feet hanging off the edge. The ankles alternately pump up and down, dorsiflexing to pull the toes toward the shins, then plantarflexing to point the toes away. The movement is rhythmic and continuous, promoting circulation and ankle mobility.

name: Seated Anterior Tibialis Strengthening
pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with your feet flat on the floor. Place a light dumbbell on the top of one foot near the toes, or use a resistance band looped around the ball of your foot.

name: Seated Arm Compressions with Towel Roll
pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with your affected arm extended in front of you at chest height. Imagine holding an imaginary towel roll along the length of your arm.

name: Seated Arm Lifts
pose_description: Sit upright in a firm chair with your feet flat on the floor and arms relaxed at your sides with elbows bent at 90 degrees. Keep your shoulders relaxed and chest open.

name: Seated Bicep Curls
pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor, arms at sides holding dumbbells with palms facing forward. Keep elbows stationary against your torso throughout the movement.

name: Seated Box Breathing
pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with your feet flat on the floor and shoulders relaxed. Keep your hands resting on your lap.

name: Seated Calf Raises
pose_description: Seated in a chair with feet flat on the floor and knees bent at 90 degrees. The heels lift off the ground as high as possible, pushing up onto the balls of the feet while the toes remain on the floor. Additional weight may be placed on the knees for resistance. The movement is controlled up and down.

name: Seated Calf Stretch
pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with one leg extended in front of you and the other bent with foot on the floor. Keep your back upright against the chair.

name: Seated Calf Stretches
pose_description: Sit upright in a chair. Extend one leg forward with the heel resting on the floor and the toes pointed towards the ceiling. The other foot remains flat on the floor with the knee bent at approximately 90 degrees.

name: Seated Cat-Cow Stretch
pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor and hands placed behind the head or crossed over chest. Engage your core lightly.

name: Seated Cervical Retraction
pose_description: Seated in a chair with good upright posture, shoulders relaxed, and feet flat on the floor. The chin draws straight backward in a horizontal motion, creating a double chin, without tilting the head up or down. The movement retracts the cervical spine, strengthening the deep neck flexors. The gaze remains level throughout.

name: Seated Chest Press
pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor, holding dumbbells at chest level with elbows bent and palms facing forward. Keep your back against the chair for support.

name: Seated Chest Stretch with Breathing
pose_description: Sit upright on a chair with feet flat on the floor, hands clasped gently behind your head. Keep your shoulders relaxed and elbows out to the sides.

name: Seated Chin Tucks
pose_description: Sit upright with good posture, eyes looking straight ahead, and shoulders relaxed. Your spine is neutral and supported against the chair back.

name: Seated Core Breathing
pose_description: Sit upright in a sturdy chair with feet flat on the floor and hands resting on your abdomen or thighs. Keep your shoulders relaxed and maintain proper posture against the chair back.

name: Seated Deep Breathing
pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor and shoulders relaxed down and back. Place one hand on your chest and one on your belly.

name: Seated Doorway Chest Stretch
pose_description: Sit upright in a chair next to a doorframe with your affected arm at 90-degree shoulder abduction, elbow bent, and forearm resting against the doorframe. Your upper arm is parallel to the ground.

name: Seated Dorsiflexion
pose_description: Patient sits upright in a firm chair with both feet flat on the floor. The affected leg remains relaxed with the foot resting naturally on the floor.

name: Seated Elbow Flexion Active Assist
pose_description: Sit upright with your repaired arm resting on your lap, elbow extended. Your uninvolved arm is positioned nearby to provide assistance.

name: Seated Eye Circles
pose_description: Sit upright with your head still and neutral, eyes open and facing forward. Keep your neck relaxed and shoulders in a neutral position.

name: Seated Eye Tracking
pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor and head still, focusing straight ahead. Keep your shoulders and neck relaxed.

name: Seated Figure-4 Stretch
pose_description: Sit upright on the floor with both legs extended in front of you. Bend one knee and place that ankle across the opposite leg's thigh, forming a figure-4 shape.

name: Seated Figure Four Hip Stretch

name: Stationary Bike with Resistance
pose_description: Sit on the bike seat with feet flat on the pedals, hands on the handlebars, and back upright. Adjust the seat height so your knee is slightly bent at the bottom of the pedal stroke.

name: Low-Impact Cardio - Stationary Cycling
pose_description: Sit on a stationary bike with your seat adjusted so your knee is slightly bent at the bottom of the pedal stroke. Grip the handlebars lightly with a neutral wrist position.

name: Step-Ups
pose_description: Standing upright facing a low step or platform approximately 6 to 8 inches high. One foot is placed entirely on the step, and the body is driven upward by pressing through that foot until standing tall on the step with both feet. Arms may be at sides or held at the waist for balance.

name: Step-Ups (Low Step)
pose_description: Stand facing a low step, curb, or bottom stair (2-4 inches high) with feet hip-width apart and arms at your sides. Maintain upright posture with shoulders back.

name: Sternocleidomastoid Stretch - Affected Side
pose_description: Sit upright with good posture and shoulders relaxed. Keep your eyes forward and neck in neutral position.

name: Straight Leg Raises
pose_description: Lying flat on back with one knee bent and foot flat on the floor for support. The other leg is lifted straight off the ground to approximately 45 degrees with the knee fully locked and toes pointed toward the ceiling. Arms rest at sides, and the lower back maintains contact with the floor.

name: Submental Isometric Exercise
pose_description: Sit upright and place your index and middle fingers under your chin. Keep your mouth closed with teeth lightly touching.

name: Superman Exercise
pose_description: Lying face down with arms extended overhead on the floor and legs straight behind. Both arms and both legs simultaneously lift off the floor, arching the back and engaging the erector spinae and glutes. The head lifts with the chest and the gaze is directed at the floor. The position is held briefly at the top with the body forming a shallow U shape.

name: Superman Hold
pose_description: Lie face-down on the floor with your arms extended overhead and legs straight, forehead neutral on the ground. Your entire body is in contact with the floor.

name: Supine Achilles Stretch
pose_description: Lie on your back with both legs extended on the floor. Use a towel or resistance band looped around the ball of one foot.

name: Supine Adductor Stretch
pose_description: Lie on your back with both knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Position your feet hip-width apart with arms at your sides.

name: Seated Arm Lifts (Supine)
pose_description: Lie flat on your back with arms at your sides, palms facing down, and elbows slightly bent. Keep your chest open and shoulders relaxed.

name: Supine Arm Slides
pose_description: Lie on your back on a firm surface with both arms at your sides, palms facing down. Keep your knees slightly bent with feet flat on the floor for comfort.

name: Supine Breathing Exercises
pose_description: Lie flat on your back with knees bent, feet flat, and a pillow under your head for comfort. Place one hand on your chest and one on your belly.

name: Supine Bridge
pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor hip-width apart, and arms at your sides. Keep your neck relaxed and head supported by the floor.

name: Supine Bridge with Foot Focus
pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor hip-width apart, and arms at your sides with palms down. Position feet parallel with weight on the outer edges.

name: Supine Bridge Hold
pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor hip-width apart. Arms are at your sides with palms down.

name: Supine Bridge with Shoulder Engagement
pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat and hip-width apart. Arms are at your sides with palms down and elbows slightly bent.

name: Supine Butterfly Stretch
pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent and bring the soles of your feet together, allowing your knees to fall open to the sides. Rest your arms at your sides with palms up.

name: Supine Chest Stretch
pose_description: Lie on your back with your repaired arm positioned out to the side at 90 degrees, elbow slightly bent. Your uninvolved arm rests across your body.

name: Supine Core Engagement with Neutral Spine
pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor, and arms at your sides. Maintain a neutral spine with a small gap between your lower back and the floor.

name: Supine Elbow Flexion with Arm Support
pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent and the affected arm resting at your side with elbow extended. Place a small pillow under the affected arm for support.

name: Supine External Rotation Bent Elbow Regen
pose_description: (none)

name: Supine External Rotation Dumbbell Regen
pose_description: (none)

name: Supine Eye Movements
pose_description: Lie flat on your back with knees bent and feet flat on floor. Keep your head still and focus on a fixed point on the ceiling above.

name: Supine Figure-4 Stretch
pose_description: Lie on your back with both knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Cross your right ankle over your left thigh just above the knee.

name: Supine Figure-4 Stretch with Pelvic Mobilization
pose_description: Lying flat on back with one ankle crossed over the opposite knee in a figure-four position. Both hands reach through and clasp behind the thigh of the bottom leg, pulling it toward the chest. Additionally, the pelvis gently rocks side to side in small mobilization movements, enhancing the stretch through the piriformis and outer hip of the crossed leg.

name: Supine Figure Four Stretch
pose_description: Lie on your back with both knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Cross your right ankle over your left knee to form a figure-four shape.

name: Supine Glute Activation
pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, positioned directly under your knees. Arms are at your sides.

name: Supine Glute Bridge
pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, positioned hip-width apart and close to your buttocks. Place arms at your sides with palms down.

name: Supine Glute Bridges
pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor hip-width apart, and arms at your sides. Keep your head and shoulders relaxed on the floor.

name: Supine Glute Squeeze
pose_description: Lie flat on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the bed, positioned hip-width apart. Rest your arms at your sides with palms down.

name: Supine Gluteal Bridge
pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, positioned hip-width apart and arms at your sides. Position feet approximately 12 inches from your buttocks.

name: Supine Hamstring Curls
pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Keep the affected leg in a comfortable position.

name: Supine Hamstring Stretch
pose_description: Lying flat on back with one leg extended on the floor. The other leg is raised straight up toward the ceiling with the knee as straight as possible, hands clasped behind the thigh or a strap looped around the foot to assist the stretch. The hips remain flat on the floor and the lower back maintains a neutral position.

name: Supine Head Turns with Stabilization
pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Rest your arms at your sides with eyes focused on the ceiling.

name: Supine Hip Abduction
pose_description: Lie on your back with both knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Keep your arms at your sides for stability.

name: Supine Hip Bridge Hold
pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, positioned hip-width apart. Place a resistance band above the knees for added engagement.

name: Supine Hip Bridges
pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor hip-width apart, and arms at your sides. Keep the affected leg in a comfortable, supported position.

name: Supine Hip Circles
pose_description: Lie on your back on a firm surface with one knee bent and foot flat on the floor. Keep the other leg extended or slightly bent for comfort.

name: Supine Hip Flexion
pose_description: Lying flat on back with both legs extended. One knee bends and lifts toward the chest, driven by the hip flexors, bringing the thigh to approximately 90 degrees of hip flexion. The opposite leg remains flat on the floor, the lower back stays neutral, and the hands may gently guide the knee.

name: Supine Hip Flexion with Knee Extension
pose_description: Lie on your back with both knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Keep your lower back neutral and relaxed.

name: Supine Hip Flexion March
pose_description: Patient lies on their back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor hip-width apart. Arms are at the sides with palms down for stability.

name: Supine Hip Flexor Stretch
pose_description: Lie on your back on a mat with both legs extended. Pull one knee toward your chest while keeping the opposite leg straight on the floor.

name: Supine Hip and Knee Flexion
pose_description: Lie flat on your back on a comfortable surface with legs extended and arms at your sides. Keep your head in a neutral position.

name: Supine Hip Marching
pose_description: Lie flat on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, positioned hip-width apart. Keep your arms at your sides with palms down for stability.

name: Supine Iliopsoas Stretch
pose_description: A person lies supine on a treatment table with their back flat, positioned towards the edge. One knee is bent and pulled towards the chest, held by both hands clasped over the shin. The opposite leg hangs straight down off the edge of the table, with the thigh extending below the table's surface.

name: Supine Isometric Shoulder Hold
pose_description: Lie on your back with the repaired arm positioned at 45 degrees away from your body, elbow slightly bent. Your forearm points upward toward the ceiling.

name: Supine Knee Flexion
pose_description: Lie on your back with both legs extended on the floor or a bed. Keep your pelvis neutral and relaxed.

name: Supine Knee to Chest
pose_description: Lie flat on your back with both legs extended on the floor. Keep your head neutral and arms at your sides.

name: Supine Knee to Chest Stretch
pose_description: Lie on your back on a padded surface with both legs extended and arms at your sides. Keep your head and shoulders relaxed on the floor.

name: Supine Leg Slides
pose_description: Lie on your back on a firm surface with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Your arms rest at your sides with palms down, and your spine maintains its natural curve with a neutral pelvis.

name: Supine Marching
pose_description: Lying flat on back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor. One knee lifts toward the chest to approximately 90 degrees of hip flexion while the opposite foot remains on the floor. The legs alternate in a slow marching motion, and the lower back stays pressed against the floor with the core engaged throughout.

name: Supine Passive Range of Motion
pose_description: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Your affected arm is at your side with the elbow bent to 90 degrees and palm facing up.

name: Supine Pelvic Floor Engagement
pose_description: Lie flat on your back on a firm surface with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Keep arms at your sides with palms down.

name: Supine Pelvic Floor Relaxation
pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Let your arms rest at your sides with palms facing up.

name: Supine Pelvic Tilt
pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, positioned hip-width apart. Your arms rest at your sides with palms down.

name: Supine Pelvic Tilts
pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor about hip-width apart. Keep arms at your sides with palms down on the floor.

name: Supine Piriformis Stretch
pose_description: Lying flat on back with both knees bent and feet flat on the floor. One ankle crosses over the opposite knee in a figure-four position. Both hands reach through the gap and clasp behind the thigh of the bottom leg, pulling it toward the chest. A deep stretch is felt in the outer hip and glute of the crossed leg.

name: Supine Prone Walk
pose_description: Lie on your back with both arms at your sides, legs extended. Your core is gently engaged and your spine maintains neutral alignment.

name: Supine Quad Sets
pose_description: Lie on your back with both legs extended on the floor. Place a small towel roll under the knee of the affected leg.

name: Supine Shoulder Abduction Slide
pose_description: Lie on your back with both arms at your sides, palms facing down on the surface. Your shoulders are relaxed and in neutral alignment.

name: Supine Shoulder Blade Retraction
pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Arms are extended straight up toward the ceiling with palms facing each other.

name: Supine Shoulder Blade Retractions
pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Place your arms at 90 degrees to your body with elbows slightly bent and palms facing up.

name: Supine Shoulder Blade Squeezes
pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, arms at your sides with palms down. Keep your neck neutral and shoulders relaxed away from your ears.

name: Supine Shoulder External Rotation Regen
pose_description: (none)

name: Supine Shoulder Flexion
pose_description: Lie on your back on a firm surface with both arms at your sides, palms facing down. Keep your core engaged and press your lower back gently into the surface.

name: Supine Shoulder Flexion with Pulley
pose_description: Lie on your back on a bench with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Hold a light dumbbell or medicine ball in your affected arm with elbow slightly bent at your side.

name: Supine Shoulder Flexion with Towel
pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat. Hold a towel roll or small foam roller horizontally across your chest at shoulder height with both hands.

name: Supine Shoulder Rotation Regen
pose_description: (none)

name: Supine Shoulder Shrugs
pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat, arms at your sides with palms facing down. Your shoulders are relaxed and in neutral position.

name: Supine Wrist Pronation Stretch
pose_description: Lie on your back with your affected arm extended out to the side at shoulder height, elbow straight, and palm facing up. Keep your shoulder relaxed and stable.

name: Supported Cat-Cow Stretch
pose_description: On hands and knees with a yoga block or cushion under the hands for wrist support, or with forearms on a chair seat for reduced wrist loading. The spine alternates between arching downward with the chest lifting and belly dropping (cow) and rounding upward with the chin tucking and tailbone curling under (cat). The movements are slow and synchronized with breathing.

name: Supported Child's Pose
pose_description: Kneel on the floor and sit your hips back toward your heels, placing a foam roller or pillow under your chest for support. Let your arms rest alongside your body.

name: Supported Deep Squat
pose_description: Stand facing a wall or sturdy support with feet shoulder-width apart and hands on the wall for balance. Keep your chest upright and core engaged.

name: Supported Squats to Chair
pose_description: Stand in front of a sturdy chair with feet hip-width apart and hands resting lightly on the chair back for support. Keep your chest up and core engaged.

name: Supported Wall Push-Up
pose_description: Stand facing a wall about 18 inches away with feet hip-width apart and hands placed on the wall at shoulder height. Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.

name: Sustained PIP Extension with Gravity Resistance
pose_description: Sit with your arm extended forward and palm facing down at shoulder height. Allow your affected finger to hang in a slightly flexed position beneath your hand.

name: Swimmers Exercise
pose_description: The person lies prone on the floor with arms extended straight overhead, palms facing down. Legs are extended straight behind them, and the head is in a neutral alignment with the spine.

name: Tall Kneeling Quadriceps Stretch
pose_description: Kneel on the floor with your knees hip-width apart and torso upright. Hands can be placed on your thighs or behind you for balance.

name: Tall Kneeling Shoulder Stability
pose_description: Begin in a tall kneeling position with knees hip-width apart, core engaged, and hands on a stability ball or light medicine ball at chest height. Keep your torso upright.

name: Tandem Stance
pose_description: Stand upright with feet together and arms at your sides or extended outward for balance. Keep your gaze fixed on a point at eye level.

name: Tandem Stance Balance
pose_description: Stand with feet hip-width apart, arms at sides or extended for balance. Look straight ahead with a neutral spine.

name: Tandem Stance Gaze Stabilization
pose_description: Stand in a tandem stance (one foot directly in front of the other) with arms out for balance. Focus your gaze on a fixed target at eye level.

name: Tandem Stance (Heel-to-Toe)
pose_description: Stand with one foot directly in front of the other in a heel-to-toe position, with arms at your sides or extended for balance. Shift your weight evenly between both feet.

name: Tandem Stance Hold
pose_description: Stand with feet together, arms at sides or extended forward for balance. Look straight ahead with a neutral spine.

name: Tandem Stance with Wall Support
pose_description: Stand sideways next to a wall with your hand lightly resting on it for balance. Position feet parallel and hip-width apart.

name: Tandem Standing
pose_description: Stand with feet together near a wall or sturdy support that you can hold if needed. Keep your posture upright and eyes focused on a fixed point ahead.

name: Tandem Walk - Heel to Toe
pose_description: Stand upright with feet together, ready to walk in a straight line with one foot placed directly in front of the other in a heel-to-toe pattern. Keep arms out to the sides for balance.

name: Tandem Walking
pose_description: Stand upright next to a wall or sturdy railing for light support. Position your feet in a heel-to-toe alignment as if walking a narrow line.

name: Tendon Gliding Exercises
pose_description: Sit with your right hand relaxed and fingers extended on a table surface. Keep your wrist in a neutral position throughout the exercise.

name: Terminal Knee Extension
pose_description: Standing with a resistance band looped behind the knee, anchored to a fixed point behind the body. The knee starts in a slightly bent position, approximately 20 to 30 degrees of flexion. The leg presses forward and straightens fully against the band resistance, achieving complete knee extension. The standing leg and torso remain upright.

name: Thoracic Extension
pose_description: Standing upright or seated in a chair with hands clasped behind the head. The upper back gently arches backward, extending through the thoracic spine while the lumbar spine stays relatively neutral. The elbows pull back and the chest lifts toward the ceiling, opening the front of the body. The movement is controlled and focused on the mid-back region.

name: Thoracic Spine Extension Stretch
pose_description: Sit upright and clasp your hands behind your head with your elbows wide. Your feet are flat on the floor.

name: Thoracic Spine Extension Stretch
pose_description: Sit upright and clasp your hands behind your head with elbows pointing outward. Your shoulders are relaxed and your spine is in neutral.

name: Thumb Abduction Against Resistance
pose_description: Sit upright with your hand flat on a table, palm down. Your thumb is positioned close to your index finger in a neutral position.

name: Thumb Abduction Stretch
pose_description: Sit with your forearm resting on a table with your palm facing down. Your hand is relaxed in a neutral position.

name: Thumb Abduction with Towel Roll
pose_description: Sit with your hand resting palm-down on a table, fingers relaxed. Place a rolled towel under your hand for support.

name: Thumb Adduction Strengthening
pose_description: Sit with your hand flat on a table, palm down, with your thumb abducted away from your index finger. Place a soft object like a foam ball between thumb and palm.

name: Thumb CMC Joint Stabilization
pose_description: Sit with your hand resting palm-up on a table. Your thumb is relaxed and positioned naturally away from your fingers.

name: Thumb-Finger Pinch and Release
pose_description: Sit with your hand relaxed in your lap, fingers and thumb in neutral position. Keep your wrist straight and stable.

name: Thumb Flexor Stretch
pose_description: Sit comfortably with one arm extended in front of you at shoulder height, palm facing up. Use your opposite hand to gently hold your thumb.

name: Thumb IP Joint Flexion Hold
pose_description: Sit with your hand resting palm-up on a table, with your thumb extended and straight. Your other hand is ready to provide gentle resistance at the thumb tip.

name: Thumb Isometric Stabilization
pose_description: Sit with your forearm supported and your hand open on a table. Place your other hand's index finger against the side of your thumb.

name: Thumb MCP Joint Flexion Strengthening
pose_description: Sit with your forearm supported on a table, palm facing down. Your thumb is extended straight out from your hand with other fingers relaxed.

name: Isolated Thumb MCP Joint Stabilization
pose_description: Sit with your hand resting on a table, palm down, with a light resistance band wrapped loosely around your thumb and index finger. Your thumb is in a relaxed neutral position.

name: Thumb Opposition Exercise
pose_description: Sit with your hand resting on a table, palm facing upward with all fingers extended. Keep your wrist in a neutral position.

name: Thumb Opposition Exercises
pose_description: Sit with your hand resting on a table, all fingers extended and relaxed. Keep your thumb in a neutral position.

name: Thumb Opposition Isometric Hold
pose_description: Sit upright with your forearm resting on a table, palm facing up. Your thumb is relaxed and in a neutral position away from your fingers.

name: Thumb and Wrist Stretch
pose_description: Sit with your affected arm extended in front of you, palm facing forward. Use your opposite hand to gently hold your affected thumb.

name: Tibialis Anterior Strengthening
pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with your feet flat on the floor, knees bent at 90 degrees. Your back is against the chair and core is engaged.

name: Temporomandibular Joint Mobilization
pose_description: Sit upright with your mouth gently closed and jaw relaxed. Place your index and middle fingers on your chin.

name: Toe Raises
pose_description: Standing upright with feet hip-width apart, lightly holding a wall or chair for balance. The toes and forefoot lift off the ground while the heels remain planted, dorsiflexing the ankles and engaging the tibialis anterior. The body weight shifts slightly back onto the heels, and the torso stays upright.

name: Toe Spreads
pose_description: Sit in a chair with feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Keep your heel planted and focus on the big toe.

name: Toe Taps
pose_description: Sit in a chair with your feet flat on the floor. Your legs are relaxed and your feet are hip-width apart.

name: Toe Taps with Foot Elevated
pose_description: Sit upright with one leg extended on a bench or ottoman with your heel supported. Keep your toes pointing downward in a relaxed position.

name: Toe Walks on Heels
pose_description: Stand upright and rise onto your heels, lifting your toes off the ground. Keep your posture tall and shoulders back.

name: Tongue Press and Lateral Movement
pose_description: Sit upright with your mouth slightly open and your tongue in the center of your mouth. Keep your head still and shoulders relaxed.

name: Tongue Strengthening Exercise
pose_description: Sit upright with your mouth closed and teeth together lightly. Position your tongue tip against the roof of your mouth.

name: Tongue-to-Palate Exercise
pose_description: Sit upright with your mouth closed and your jaw relaxed in a neutral position. Breathe normally through your nose.

name: Towel Curl - Foot
pose_description: Sit upright with bare feet on a flat surface with a towel placed lengthwise in front of you. Rest your foot on one end of the towel with toes relaxed.

name: Towel Curls
pose_description: Seated in a chair with feet flat on the floor and a small towel laid flat beneath the toes. The toes scrunch and grip the towel, pulling it toward the heel in a curling motion. The heel remains firmly on the floor throughout, and the ankle does not move — only the toes actively work to gather the towel.

name: Towel Curls for Foot Intrinsics
pose_description: Sit in a chair with your bare foot flat on the floor on top of a small towel or cloth. Your foot should be relaxed with toes extended naturally.

name: Towel Grip and Release
pose_description: Sit with a rolled towel on a table in front of you. Place your open hand flat on top of the towel with fingers extended and relaxed.

name: Intrinsic Foot Strengthening (Towel Scrunch)
pose_description: Sit with feet flat on the floor with a small towel spread out in front of you. Your toes are relaxed and extended on the towel.

name: Towel Scrunches
pose_description: Sit in a chair with feet flat on the floor, placing a small towel on the ground in front of you. Keep your heel on the ground while your toes rest on the towel.

name: Towel Stretch
pose_description: Stand upright and hold a towel vertically with both hands, with your unaffected arm raised overhead holding the top of the towel. Your affected arm is below, holding the bottom of the towel with the elbow bent.

name: Towel Wrist Rolls
pose_description: Sit upright with your arm extended in front of you at shoulder height, holding a small towel with a loose grip. Your wrist is in a neutral position.

name: Transverse Abdominis Activation
pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor, and arms at your sides. Relax your breathing and prepare to engage your deep core muscles.

name: Transverse Abdominis Engagement
pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor and shoulders relaxed. Place your hands on your lower abdomen below the navel.

name: Treadmill Gait Training
pose_description: Patient stands on a treadmill with feet hip-width apart, holding the handrails lightly for balance and safety. The machine is set at a slow speed appropriate for the patient's function level.

name: Treadmill Walking Progression
pose_description: Stand on the treadmill with one hand lightly resting on the handrail for balance and safety. Start at a slow, comfortable walking speed with good upright posture.

name: Treadmill Walking with Interval Training
pose_description: Stand upright on the treadmill with feet hip-width apart and hands lightly gripping the handrails. Begin at a slow, comfortable walking pace to warm up.

name: Treadmill Walking - Progressive Speed
pose_description: Stand on a treadmill at a slow comfortable walking speed (2-3 mph) with hands lightly on the rails. Focus your gaze straight ahead at eye level.

name: Tricep Extensions
pose_description: Standing upright holding a dumbbell or resistance band overhead with both hands or one hand. The elbow points toward the ceiling and the forearm lowers behind the head by bending at the elbow, then extends back to full lockout overhead. The upper arm remains stationary next to the ear, and the core is braced.

name: Ulnar Nerve Glide
pose_description: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart and the body facing forward. The affected arm is relaxed at the side with the palm facing the body.

name: Nerve Gliding Exercises
pose_description: Sit with your affected arm at your side, elbow bent at 90 degrees, fist clenched. Your hand is relaxed and close to your body.

name: Ulnar Nerve Mobilization Stretch
pose_description: Sit upright and position your affected arm at 90 degrees to your body with elbow extended. Your palm faces upward and your head is in neutral position.

name: Upper Extremity Pendulum Swings
pose_description: Stand with your affected arm hanging relaxed at your side. Bend slightly at the waist to allow your arm to swing freely.

name: Upper Trapezius Release
pose_description: Sit upright with both feet flat on the floor and maintain neutral posture. Place your right hand across your chest and grasp your left shoulder.

name: Upper Trapezius Stretch
pose_description: Standing or seated upright. One hand reaches behind the back or holds the seat of a chair to depress that shoulder. The head tilts toward the opposite side, bringing the ear toward the shoulder, and the free hand may gently rest on the head to add a mild overpressure. A stretch is felt along the side of the neck and upper trapezius.

name: Vertical Head Nods with Fixation
pose_description: Stand with good posture, feet hip-width apart, looking straight ahead at a focal point. Keep your arms relaxed at your sides.

name: Vestibular Walk
pose_description: Stand upright with proper posture and arms at your sides. Choose a clear walking path in front of you.

name: Walking
pose_description: Standing upright with good posture, chin level, shoulders relaxed, and arms swinging naturally at sides. One foot is stepping forward in a natural heel-to-toe gait pattern, with the opposite arm swinging forward for counterbalance. The core is engaged and the gaze is directed forward.

name: Walking Lunges
pose_description: Stand tall with feet together and hands on hips or extended for balance. Engage your core and maintain an upright posture.

name: Walking with Metronome Pacing
pose_description: Stand upright in an open space, ready to walk at a comfortable pace. Focus on maintaining an even breathing rhythm synchronized with your steps.

name: Wall Angel
pose_description: Standing with the back, head, and buttocks flat against a wall. Arms are raised with the backs of the hands, wrists, and elbows pressed against the wall in a goalpost position. The arms slide upward along the wall toward full overhead extension and back down, maintaining constant contact between the arms and the wall throughout the arc of movement.

name: Wall Angel Stretch
pose_description: Stand with your back against a wall, feet about 6 inches away from the base. Your arms are at shoulder height with elbows bent at 90 degrees against the wall.

name: Wall Angels
pose_description: Stand with your back against a wall, feet about 6 inches away, and arms at shoulder height in a goalpost position. Keep your head, shoulders, and lower back in contact with the wall.

name: Wall Ankle Stretches
pose_description: Sit in a chair with your back against a wall or in a comfortable position. Cross one ankle over the opposite knee.

name: Wall Push-Up
pose_description: Stand facing a wall with feet hip-width apart and hands on the wall at shoulder height. Your body should form a diagonal line from head to heels.

name: Wall Push-Ups
pose_description: Standing approximately arm's length from a wall with hands placed flat on the wall at shoulder height and shoulder-width apart. The body leans forward toward the wall by bending the elbows, then pushes back to the starting position. The body maintains a straight line from head to heels, with the core engaged and heels slightly lifted.

name: Wall Push-Ups Modified
pose_description: Stand facing a wall at arm's length away with feet shoulder-width apart and palms placed flat against the wall at shoulder height. Keep your body straight from head to heels.

name: Wall Sits
pose_description: Doing a wall sit exercise: back flat against a wall, knees bent at 90 degrees in a deep squat, thighs parallel to the floor, like sitting in an invisible chair. Feet flat on the floor shoulder-width apart. Arms at sides. The hips are at the same height as the knees, NOT on the ground.

name: Wall Sits with Knee Alignment
pose_description: Stand with your back against a wall, feet shoulder-width apart and about 12 inches away from the wall. Engage your core and ensure proper knee alignment.

name: Wall Sits with Sensory Focus
pose_description: Stand with your back against a wall, feet hip-width apart and positioned about 12 inches away from the wall. Hands are at your sides or on your thighs.

name: Wall Slide
pose_description: Stand with your back against a wall, feet 6 inches away, with your arms at shoulder height and elbows bent to 90 degrees against the wall. Keep your lower back pressed against the wall.

name: Wall Slides
pose_description: Standing with back flat against a wall. Both arms are raised in a goalpost or W shape with elbows bent at 90 degrees, backs of hands and forearms touching the wall. Feet are close to the wall. This is NOT a pull-up — there is no bar. The person is standing against a flat wall with arms in a W shape.

name: Wall Squat Hold
pose_description: Stand with your back against a wall, feet hip-width apart and positioned about 12 inches away from the wall. Hold dumbbells at your sides.

name: Warm Compress and Rest
pose_description: Sit comfortably in a chair with your hand resting in your lap or on a table. Prepare to apply warm, moist heat to the affected hand.

name: World's Greatest Stretch
pose_description: Stand with feet hip-width apart and arms at your sides. Step your right foot forward into a lunge position.

name: Wrist Circles
pose_description: Standing or seated with the forearm supported or the arm extended in front. The hand draws slow circles in the air by rotating at the wrist joint, moving through flexion, radial deviation, extension, and ulnar deviation in a smooth continuous motion. The forearm remains still and the movement is isolated to the wrist.

name: Wrist Circles and Mobility
pose_description: Sit comfortably with your forearm supported on a table and your hand hanging relaxed off the edge. Keep your elbow stable.

name: Wrist Curls
pose_description: Seated or standing with the forearm resting on a table or thigh, palm facing up, holding a light dumbbell. The wrist curls upward, lifting the weight by flexing the wrist while the forearm remains stationary. The fingers may open slightly at the bottom and close at the top to increase range of motion.

name: Wrist Extension Stretch
pose_description: Sit upright with your forearm resting on a table, palm facing up. Your wrist hangs slightly off the edge of the table.

name: Wrist Extension with Thumb
pose_description: Sit upright with your forearm resting on a table, palm facing down. Your wrist and thumb are in a neutral, relaxed position.

name: Wrist Extensor Stretch
pose_description: Standing or seated with one arm extended straight in front at shoulder height, palm facing down. The opposite hand grasps the back of the hand and gently pulls it downward, flexing the wrist. A stretch is felt along the outer forearm and wrist extensor muscles. The elbow of the stretching arm remains straight.

name: Wrist Flexion and Extension
pose_description: Sit with your forearm supported on a table, palm facing down. Keep your hand relaxed in a neutral position.

name: Wrist Flexion Stretch
pose_description: Sit upright with your forearm resting on a table, palm facing down. Your wrist hangs slightly off the edge of the table.

name: Wrist Flexor Stretch
pose_description: Standing or seated with one arm extended straight in front at shoulder height, palm facing up. The opposite hand grasps the fingers and gently pulls them downward and back toward the body, extending the wrist. A stretch is felt along the inner forearm and wrist flexor muscles. The elbow of the stretching arm remains straight.

name: Wrist Isometric Hold
pose_description: Sit upright with your forearm supported on a table, wrist in neutral position with palm facing sideways. Your opposite hand is positioned to provide resistance.

name: Wrist Isometric Strengthening
pose_description: Sit with your forearm supported on a table, hand hanging off the edge in a neutral position. Use your opposite hand to provide gentle resistance.

name: Wrist Pronation and Supination
pose_description: Seated or standing with the elbow bent at 90 degrees and held at the side, or the forearm resting on a table. Holding a light hammer or weight, the forearm rotates so the palm turns face down (pronation) and then face up (supination). The elbow remains stationary and the movement is isolated to the forearm rotation.

name: Active Wrist Radial Deviation
pose_description: Sit with your forearm resting on a table in a neutral position, palm facing downward. Keep your hand relaxed with fingers extended.

name: Wrist Radial and Ulnar Deviation
pose_description: Sit with your forearm resting on a table in a neutral position, holding a light dumbbell vertically like a hammer. Your wrist is in a neutral starting position.

name: X-Pattern Gaze Tracking
pose_description: Stand facing a wall with an X-pattern drawn or imagined on it. Position yourself at a comfortable viewing distance with your gaze at the center.
